"""
Deterministic bid rules: quantities, prices, discount, surcharges, packaging, setup pool, project bonus, lead times.

Pure and model-free. The workers establish the facts and the model picks which record applies (which mail, which
revision); calc only does what the bid rules define mechanically. Money is Decimal throughout and rounds HALF_UP
only at the steps the rules name.
"""
import math
import re
from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import date, datetime
from decimal import ROUND_FLOOR, ROUND_HALF_UP, Decimal
from enum import StrEnum
from typing import Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

CENT = Decimal("0.01")
HUNDRED = Decimal(100)


class CalcError(ValueError):
    """The facts are incomplete or contradictory, so a field cannot be computed."""


def money(value: Decimal) -> Decimal:
    """Round HALF_UP to cents."""
    return value.quantize(CENT, rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)


def position_key(position: str) -> tuple:
    """Natural sort key for position identifiers, so "2" sorts before "10" and "1.2" before "1.10"."""
    return tuple((0, int(part), "") if part.isdigit() else (1, 0, part) for part in re.findall(r"\d+|\D+", position))


def _day(value: date | datetime) -> date:
    return value.date() if isinstance(value, datetime) else value


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- input models


class Unit(StrEnum):
    PIECE = "piece"
    SET = "set"


def parse_unit(text: str) -> Unit:
    """Map a stated unit (Stück, St, ST, pcs, Satz, Sätze, Set) to a Unit."""
    t = text.strip().lower().rstrip(".")
    if t.startswith(("satz", "sätz", "saetz", "set")):
        return Unit.SET
    if t in {"st", "stk", "stck", "stück", "stueck", "pc", "pcs", "piece", "pieces"}:
        return Unit.PIECE
    raise CalcError(f"unknown unit {text!r}")


class DiscountScope(StrEnum):
    """What the order-level discount applies to for one position (rule 12; setup is never discounted)."""
    BASE_ONLY = "base_only"
    BASE_AND_SURCHARGE = "base_and_surcharge"
    NONE = "none"


class PriceScale(BaseModel):
    min_quantity: int = Field(ge=0, description="Scale reached from this many final pieces")
    price: Decimal = Field(description="Price per price unit, in the condition's currency")


class PriceCondition(BaseModel):
    """One ERP price condition record (rule 22). Price unit is the number of pieces the price refers to (1, 100)."""
    valid_from: date
    valid_to: date | None = None
    currency: str = "EUR"
    fx_key: str | None = None
    price_unit: int = Field(default=1, gt=0)
    scales: list[PriceScale]


class Material(BaseModel):
    """The chosen active ERP material with the attributes calc needs."""
    material_number: str
    free_stock: int = Field(default=0, description="Unrestricted free stock in pieces, not blocked stock")
    stock_lead_time_weeks: int
    production_lead_time_weeks: int
    pieces_per_carton: int | None = Field(default=None, gt=0)
    allocation_mass: Decimal = Field(default=Decimal(0), description="kg per piece, used for the setup pool")
    surcharge_mass: Decimal = Field(default=Decimal(0), description="kg per piece, used for the metal surcharge")
    metal_index: str | None = Field(default=None, description="Metal index code; None = the only index given")


class MetalIndexRate(BaseModel):
    """EUR per kg; a missing bound means the window is open on that side."""
    rate: Decimal
    valid_from: date | None = None
    valid_to: date | None = None


class PackagingTariff(BaseModel):
    price_per_carton: Decimal = Field(description="EUR per carton")


class DeliveryCommitment(BaseModel):
    """Terminfreigabe for one position (rule 24)."""
    material_number: str
    ceiling: int = Field(description="Inclusive maximum pooled demand in pieces for the material")
    lead_time_weeks: int


class CentAllocation(StrEnum):
    """
    How the setup pool fee is split into cents (rule 25: the rule is stated in the Ruestpools mail).

    LARGEST_REMAINDER: floor every exact share, hand out the missing cents by largest fractional part.
    ROUND_EACH: round every share HALF_UP, no correction (the sum may differ from the fee by a few cents).
    REST_TO_LARGEST / REST_TO_FIRST / REST_TO_LAST: round (or floor, see SetupPool.rest_base) every share, then the
    difference to the fee goes to the member with the largest weight / the first / the last member by tie order.
    """
    LARGEST_REMAINDER = "largest_remainder"
    ROUND_EACH = "round_each"
    REST_TO_LARGEST = "rest_to_largest"
    REST_TO_FIRST = "rest_to_first"
    REST_TO_LAST = "rest_to_last"


class TieOrder(StrEnum):
    ASCENDING = "ascending"
    DESCENDING = "descending"


class SetupPool(BaseModel):
    """Shared setup (Ruestpool): one fee split over members by final pieces x allocation mass."""
    fee: Decimal
    members: list[str]
    allocation: CentAllocation = CentAllocation.LARGEST_REMAINDER
    tie_order: TieOrder = Field(default=TieOrder.ASCENDING, description="Position order for ties and first/last")
    rest_base: Literal["half_up", "floor"] = "half_up"


class BonusBand(BaseModel):
    """Marginal band: percent applies to the part of the eligible total between lower and upper (None = open)."""
    lower: Decimal
    upper: Decimal | None = None
    percent: Decimal


class ProjectBonus(BaseModel):
    bands: list[BonusBand]
    members: list[str]
    include_surcharge: bool = Field(default=False, description="Assumption: goods value = pieces x EUR base price; "
                                                               "True adds the undiscounted mass surcharge")


class Approval(BaseModel):
    """The governing director approval (rules 5, 16)."""
    percent: Decimal
    min_order_value: Decimal | None = Field(default=None, description="Inclusive threshold in EUR, if conditional")


class PositionInput(BaseModel):
    position: str
    quantity: int = Field(ge=0, description="Final quantity in the stated unit (after Q&A changes, rule 1/13)")
    unit: Unit = Unit.PIECE
    pieces_per_set: int | None = Field(default=None, gt=0, description="From the governing spec, for Satz")
    material: Material | None = Field(default=None, description="None = no exactly matching active material")
    conditions: list[PriceCondition] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Candidates; calc picks the valid one")
    discount_scope: DiscountScope = DiscountScope.BASE_ONLY
    setup_fee: Decimal = Field(default=Decimal(0), description="Ordinary setup fee for the whole position, EUR")
    packaging: PackagingTariff | None = None
    commitment: DeliveryCommitment | None = None


class BidInput(BaseModel):
    tender_reference: str
    scenario_date: date
    positions: list[PositionInput]
    approval: Approval | None = None
    fx_rates: dict[str, Decimal] = Field(default_factory=dict, description="FX key (or currency) -> EUR per unit")
    metal_indices: dict[str, list[MetalIndexRate]] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    setup_pool: SetupPool | None = None
    project_bonus: ProjectBonus | None = None


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- output models


class AnswerPosition(BaseModel):
    position: str
    material_number: str
    quantity: int
    unit_price: Decimal
    lead_time_weeks: int
    base_unit_price: Decimal | None = None
    surcharge_per_unit: Decimal | None = None
    packaging_per_unit: Decimal | None = None
    rebate_total: Decimal | None = None


class PositionDebug(BaseModel):
    """Unrounded intermediates of one position."""
    position: str
    pieces: int
    pooled_demand: int
    scale_min_quantity: int
    scale_price: Decimal
    currency: str
    fx_rate: Decimal
    base_eur: Decimal
    metal_rate: Decimal
    mass_surcharge: Decimal
    discount_factor_base: Decimal
    discount_factor_surcharge: Decimal
    setup_fee: Decimal
    pool_allocation: Decimal
    cartons: int
    carton_cost: Decimal
    bonus: Decimal
    unit_price_exact: Decimal


class BidResult(BaseModel):
    tender_reference: str
    decision: Literal["bid", "no_bid"]
    currency: Literal["EUR"] = "EUR"
    discount_percent: Decimal
    positions: list[AnswerPosition]
    total_net: Decimal
    order_value: Decimal | None = Field(default=None, description="Undiscounted value for the discount threshold")
    bonus_total: Decimal | None = None
    missing_materials: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    debug: list[PositionDebug] = Field(default_factory=list)

    def answer(self, notes: str | None = None) -> dict:
        """The answer object per the answer schema, money as floats with two decimals."""
        out = {
            "tender_reference": self.tender_reference,
            "decision": self.decision,
            "currency": "EUR",
            "discount_percent": float(self.discount_percent),
            "positions": [{k: float(v) if isinstance(v, Decimal) else v
                           for k, v in p.model_dump().items() if v is not None} for p in self.positions],
            "total_net": float(self.total_net),
        }
        if notes:
            out["notes"] = notes[:4000]
        return out


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- mechanical selection helpers


class QuantityChange(BaseModel):
    number: str = Field(description="Q&A answer number")
    date: datetime
    position: str
    quantity: int


def resolve_quantity(tender_quantity: int, position: str, changes: list[QuantityChange], withdrawn: set[str],
                     scenario_date: date | None = None) -> int:
    """Rules 1 and 13: latest non-withdrawn change for the position (not future-dated), else the tender quantity."""
    live = [c for c in changes if c.position == position and c.number not in withdrawn
            and (scenario_date is None or _day(c.date) <= scenario_date)]
    if not live:
        return tender_quantity
    return max(live, key=lambda c: (c.date, position_key(c.number))).quantity


def to_pieces(quantity: int, unit: Unit, pieces_per_set: int | None) -> int:
    """Rule 17: Satz x pieces per set; pieces stay as they are."""
    if unit is Unit.PIECE:
        return quantity
    if not pieces_per_set:
        raise CalcError("quantity in sets but pieces per set unknown")
    return quantity * pieces_per_set


class Amendment(BaseModel):
    """A scoped technical amendment from the tender Q&A (rule 14)."""
    date: datetime
    revision: str
    requirement: str
    attributes: dict[str, Decimal | str]


def apply_amendments(attributes: dict[str, Decimal | str], amendments: list[Amendment], revision: str,
                     requirement: str, scenario_date: date | None = None) -> dict[str, Decimal | str]:
    """Rule 14: only amendments naming this revision and requirement; the latest dated one wins per attribute."""
    result = dict(attributes)
    latest: dict[str, datetime] = {}
    for a in amendments:
        if a.revision != revision or a.requirement != requirement:
            continue
        if scenario_date is not None and _day(a.date) > scenario_date:
            continue
        for key, value in a.attributes.items():
            if key not in latest or a.date >= latest[key]:
                latest[key] = a.date
                result[key] = value
    return result


def nominal_stroke(usable_stroke: Decimal, reserve_per_end: Decimal) -> Decimal:
    """Rule 20: nominal stroke = usable stroke (after amendments) + 2 x per-end reserve."""
    return usable_stroke + 2 * reserve_per_end


MATCH_KEYS = ("bore", "stroke", "pressure", "mounting", "certification")


def _same(a: Decimal | str, b: Decimal | str) -> bool:
    try:
        return Decimal(str(a)) == Decimal(str(b))
    except ArithmeticError:
        return " ".join(str(a).split()).casefold() == " ".join(str(b).split()).casefold()


def matching_materials(requirement: dict[str, Decimal | str], candidates: list[tuple[str, dict[str, Decimal | str]]],
                       keys: tuple[str, ...] = MATCH_KEYS) -> list[str]:
    """Rule 3: material numbers whose listed attributes all equal the requirement (numbers compared as numbers)."""
    return [number for number, attrs in candidates
            if all(k in attrs and k in requirement and _same(attrs[k], requirement[k]) for k in keys)]


class DatedRecord(BaseModel):
    """An authority record (mail) reduced to what rule 21 checks."""
    reference: str
    sender: str
    date: datetime
    key: str = ""


def latest_authoritative[R: DatedRecord](records: list[R], reference: str, scenario_date: date, sender_local: str,
                                         bidder_domain: str) -> R | None:
    """Rule 21: latest record for the exact reference from local@domain, dated no later than the scenario date."""
    sender = f"{sender_local}@{bidder_domain}".casefold()
    ok = [r for r in records if r.reference.strip() == reference.strip() and r.sender.strip().casefold() == sender
          and _day(r.date) <= scenario_date]
    return max(ok, key=lambda r: r.date) if ok else None


def valid_condition(conditions: list[PriceCondition], on: date) -> PriceCondition:
    """Rule 4: the condition whose inclusive validity contains the date (latest start if several)."""
    valid = [c for c in conditions if c.valid_from <= on and (c.valid_to is None or on <= c.valid_to)]
    if not valid:
        raise CalcError(f"no price condition valid on {on}")
    return max(valid, key=lambda c: c.valid_from)


def reached_scale(scales: list[PriceScale], pieces: int) -> PriceScale:
    """Rule 4: the highest scale whose minimum the pieces reach (per position, never the material sum)."""
    reached = [s for s in scales if s.min_quantity <= pieces]
    if not reached:
        raise CalcError(f"no price scale reached by {pieces} pieces")
    return max(reached, key=lambda s: s.min_quantity)


def metal_rate(rates: list[MetalIndexRate], on: date) -> Decimal:
    """Rule 28: the rate whose inclusive window contains the date; a single unwindowed rate applies as is."""
    hits = [r for r in rates
            if (r.valid_from is None or r.valid_from <= on) and (r.valid_to is None or on <= r.valid_to)]
    if not hits:
        raise CalcError(f"no metal index rate valid on {on}")
    windowed = [r for r in hits if r.valid_from is not None or r.valid_to is not None]
    return (windowed or hits)[-1].rate


def bonus_credit(total: Decimal, bands: list[BonusBand]) -> Decimal:
    """Rule 26: each band's percent on its own portion of the total, aggregate rounded HALF_UP to cents."""
    credit = Decimal(0)
    for band in bands:
        top = total if band.upper is None else min(total, band.upper)
        if top > band.lower:
            credit += (top - band.lower) * band.percent / HUNDRED
    return money(credit)


def allocate_cents(amount: Decimal, weights: dict[str, Decimal],
                   method: CentAllocation = CentAllocation.LARGEST_REMAINDER, tie_order: TieOrder = TieOrder.ASCENDING,
                   rest_base: Literal["half_up", "floor"] = "half_up") -> dict[str, Decimal]:
    """
    Split an amount (rounded to cents first) over positions proportionally to weights, in whole cents.

    Ties (equal remainders or equal weights) go by position order, ascending unless tie_order says otherwise.
    """
    total_weight = sum(weights.values(), Decimal(0))
    if not weights or total_weight <= 0:
        raise CalcError("allocation needs positive weights")
    cents = int(money(amount) / CENT)
    order = sorted(weights, key=position_key, reverse=tie_order is TieOrder.DESCENDING)
    exact = {p: Decimal(cents) * weights[p] / total_weight for p in order}
    if method is CentAllocation.LARGEST_REMAINDER:
        share = {p: int(exact[p].to_integral_value(ROUND_FLOOR)) for p in order}
        left = cents - sum(share.values())
        ranked = sorted(order, key=lambda p: exact[p] - share[p], reverse=True)  # stable: ties keep position order
        for p in ranked[:left]:
            share[p] += 1
    else:
        rounding = ROUND_FLOOR if (method is not CentAllocation.ROUND_EACH and rest_base == "floor") else ROUND_HALF_UP
        share = {p: int(exact[p].to_integral_value(rounding)) for p in order}
        if method is not CentAllocation.ROUND_EACH:
            target = {CentAllocation.REST_TO_FIRST: order[0], CentAllocation.REST_TO_LAST: order[-1],
                      CentAllocation.REST_TO_LARGEST: max(order, key=lambda p: weights[p])}[method]
            share[target] += cents - sum(share.values())
    return {p: Decimal(c) * CENT for p, c in share.items()}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the calculation


def _base_eur(pos: PositionInput, pieces: int, bid: BidInput) -> tuple[Decimal, PriceScale, PriceCondition, Decimal]:
    """Rule 22: price unit normalised, per-position scale, EUR per currency unit, HALF_UP to cents."""
    cond = valid_condition(pos.conditions, bid.scenario_date)
    scale = reached_scale(cond.scales, pieces)
    if cond.currency.upper() == "EUR":
        fx = Decimal(1)
    else:
        key = cond.fx_key or cond.currency
        if key not in bid.fx_rates and cond.currency not in bid.fx_rates:
            raise CalcError(f"no FX rate for {key}")
        fx = bid.fx_rates.get(key, bid.fx_rates.get(cond.currency))
    return money(scale.price / Decimal(cond.price_unit) * fx), scale, cond, fx


def _metal_rate(material: Material, bid: BidInput) -> Decimal:
    if material.surcharge_mass == 0:
        return Decimal(0)
    code = material.metal_index
    if code is None:
        if len(bid.metal_indices) != 1:
            raise CalcError(f"{material.material_number}: metal index code needed")
        code = next(iter(bid.metal_indices))
    if code not in bid.metal_indices:
        raise CalcError(f"no metal index {code}")
    return metal_rate(bid.metal_indices[code], bid.scenario_date)


def effective_discount(approval: Approval | None, order_value: Decimal | None) -> Decimal:
    """Rules 5 and 16: approved percent, or 0 when the inclusive threshold fails (or no value exists, as for no_bid)."""
    if approval is None:
        return Decimal(0)
    if approval.min_order_value is None:
        return approval.percent
    if order_value is None or order_value < approval.min_order_value:
        return Decimal(0)
    return approval.percent


def lead_time(pos: PositionInput, pooled_demand: int) -> int:
    """Rules 6, 15, 24: commitment if material matches and pooled demand is within its ceiling, else shared stock."""
    material = pos.material
    assert material is not None
    c = pos.commitment
    if c is not None and c.material_number == material.material_number and pooled_demand <= c.ceiling:
        return c.lead_time_weeks
    if material.free_stock >= pooled_demand:
        return material.stock_lead_time_weeks
    return material.production_lead_time_weeks


def calculate(bid: BidInput) -> BidResult:
    """Apply the bid rules to established facts and return the answer with intermediates."""
    missing = [p.position for p in bid.positions if p.material is None]
    if missing:
        return BidResult(tender_reference=bid.tender_reference, decision="no_bid", positions=[],
                         discount_percent=effective_discount(bid.approval, None), total_net=Decimal("0.00"),
                         missing_materials=missing)

    pieces = {p.position: to_pieces(p.quantity, p.unit, p.pieces_per_set) for p in bid.positions}
    pooled: dict[str, int] = defaultdict(int)
    for p in bid.positions:
        pooled[p.material.material_number] += pieces[p.position]  # type: ignore[union-attr]

    base: dict[str, tuple[Decimal, PriceScale, PriceCondition, Decimal]] = {
        p.position: _base_eur(p, pieces[p.position], bid) for p in bid.positions}
    rates = {p.position: _metal_rate(p.material, bid) for p in bid.positions}  # type: ignore[arg-type]
    surcharge = {p.position: p.material.surcharge_mass * rates[p.position] for p in bid.positions}  # type: ignore

    order_value = money(sum((pieces[k] * base[k][0] for k in pieces), Decimal(0)))
    discount = effective_discount(bid.approval, order_value)
    factor = 1 - discount / HUNDRED

    pool: dict[str, Decimal] = {}
    if bid.setup_pool is not None:
        by_pos = {p.position: p for p in bid.positions}
        weights = {m: pieces[m] * by_pos[m].material.allocation_mass  # type: ignore[union-attr]
                   for m in bid.setup_pool.members if m in by_pos}
        if weights:
            pool = allocate_cents(bid.setup_pool.fee, weights, bid.setup_pool.allocation, bid.setup_pool.tie_order,
                                  bid.setup_pool.rest_base)

    bonus: dict[str, Decimal] = {}
    bonus_total = None
    if bid.project_bonus is not None:
        goods = {}
        for p in bid.positions:
            if p.position in bid.project_bonus.members:
                unit = base[p.position][0] + (surcharge[p.position] if bid.project_bonus.include_surcharge else 0)
                goods[p.position] = pieces[p.position] * unit
        bonus_total = bonus_credit(money(sum(goods.values(), Decimal(0))), bid.project_bonus.bands)
        if goods and bonus_total > 0:
            bonus = allocate_cents(bonus_total, goods)

    positions, debug = [], []
    for p in bid.positions:
        k, material, n = p.position, p.material, pieces[p.position]
        assert material is not None
        base_eur, scale, cond, fx = base[k]
        f_base = factor if p.discount_scope is not DiscountScope.NONE else Decimal(1)
        f_sur = factor if p.discount_scope is DiscountScope.BASE_AND_SURCHARGE else Decimal(1)
        if n == 0:
            raise CalcError(f"{k}: zero pieces")
        cartons, carton_cost = 0, Decimal(0)
        if p.packaging is not None:
            if not material.pieces_per_carton:
                raise CalcError(f"{k}: carton size unknown")
            cartons = math.ceil(n / material.pieces_per_carton)
            carton_cost = cartons * p.packaging.price_per_carton
        setup = p.setup_fee + pool.get(k, Decimal(0))
        credit = bonus.get(k, Decimal(0))
        exact = base_eur * f_base + surcharge[k] * f_sur + (setup + carton_cost - credit) / n
        positions.append(AnswerPosition(
            position=k, material_number=material.material_number, quantity=n, unit_price=money(exact),
            lead_time_weeks=lead_time(p, pooled[material.material_number]), base_unit_price=base_eur,
            surcharge_per_unit=money(surcharge[k] + setup / n), packaging_per_unit=money(carton_cost / n),
            rebate_total=money(credit)))
        debug.append(PositionDebug(
            position=k, pieces=n, pooled_demand=pooled[material.material_number], scale_min_quantity=scale.min_quantity,
            scale_price=scale.price, currency=cond.currency, fx_rate=fx, base_eur=base_eur, metal_rate=rates[k],
            mass_surcharge=surcharge[k], discount_factor_base=f_base, discount_factor_surcharge=f_sur,
            setup_fee=p.setup_fee, pool_allocation=pool.get(k, Decimal(0)), cartons=cartons, carton_cost=carton_cost,
            bonus=credit, unit_price_exact=exact))

    total = money(sum((p.quantity * p.unit_price for p in positions), Decimal(0)))
    return BidResult(tender_reference=bid.tender_reference, decision="bid", discount_percent=discount,
                     positions=positions, total_net=total, order_value=order_value, bonus_total=bonus_total,
                     debug=debug)

toolUseResult.stdout:
"""
Deterministic bid rules: quantities, prices, discount, surcharges, packaging, setup pool, project bonus, lead times.

Pure and model-free. The workers establish the facts and the model picks which record applies (which mail, which
revision); calc only does what the bid rules define mechanically. Money is Decimal throughout and rounds HALF_UP
only at the steps the rules name.
"""
import math
import re
from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import date, datetime
from decimal import ROUND_FLOOR, ROUND_HALF_UP, Decimal
from enum import StrEnum
from typing import Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

CENT = Decimal("0.01")
HUNDRED = Decimal(100)


class CalcError(ValueError):
    """The facts are incomplete or contradictory, so a field cannot be computed."""


def money(value: Decimal) -> Decimal:
    """Round HALF_UP to cents."""
    return value.quantize(CENT, rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)


def position_key(position: str) -> tuple:
    """Natural sort key for position identifiers, so "2" sorts before "10" and "1.2" before "1.10"."""
    return tuple((0, int(part), "") if part.isdigit() else (1, 0, part) for part in re.findall(r"\d+|\D+", position))


def _day(value: date | datetime) -> date:
    return value.date() if isinstance(value, datetime) else value


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- input models


class Unit(StrEnum):
    PIECE = "piece"
    SET = "set"


def parse_unit(text: str) -> Unit:
    """Map a stated unit (Stück, St, ST, pcs, Satz, Sätze, Set) to a Unit."""
    t = text.strip().lower().rstrip(".")
    if t.startswith(("satz", "sätz", "saetz", "set")):
        return Unit.SET
    if t in {"st", "stk", "stck", "stück", "stueck", "pc", "pcs", "piece", "pieces"}:
        return Unit.PIECE
    raise CalcError(f"unknown unit {text!r}")


class DiscountScope(StrEnum):
    """What the order-level discount applies to for one position (rule 12; setup is never discounted)."""
    BASE_ONLY = "base_only"
    BASE_AND_SURCHARGE = "base_and_surcharge"
    NONE = "none"


class PriceScale(BaseModel):
    min_quantity: int = Field(ge=0, description="Scale reached from this many final pieces")
    price: Decimal = Field(description="Price per price unit, in the condition's currency")


class PriceCondition(BaseModel):
    """One ERP price condition record (rule 22). Price unit is the number of pieces the price refers to (1, 100)."""
    valid_from: date
    valid_to: date | None = None
    currency: str = "EUR"
    fx_key: str | None = None
    price_unit: int = Field(default=1, gt=0)
    scales: list[PriceScale]


class Material(BaseModel):
    """The chosen active ERP material with the attributes calc needs."""
    material_number: str
    free_stock: int = Field(default=0, description="Unrestricted free stock in pieces, not blocked stock")
    stock_lead_time_weeks: int
    production_lead_time_weeks: int
    pieces_per_carton: int | None = Field(default=None, gt=0)
    allocation_mass: Decimal = Field(default=Decimal(0), description="kg per piece, used for the setup pool")
    surcharge_mass: Decimal = Field(default=Decimal(0), description="kg per piece, used for the metal surcharge")
    metal_index: str | None = Field(default=None, description="Metal index code; None = the only index given")


class MetalIndexRate(BaseModel):
    """EUR per kg; a missing bound means the window is open on that side."""
    rate: Decimal
    valid_from: date | None = None
    valid_to: date | None = None


class PackagingTariff(BaseModel):
    price_per_carton: Decimal = Field(description="EUR per carton")


class DeliveryCommitment(BaseModel):
    """Terminfreigabe for one position (rule 24)."""
    material_number: str
    ceiling: int = Field(description="Inclusive maximum pooled demand in pieces for the material")
    lead_time_weeks: int


class CentAllocation(StrEnum):
    """
    How the setup pool fee is split into cents (rule 25: the rule is stated in the Ruestpools mail).

    LARGEST_REMAINDER: floor every exact share, hand out the missing cents by largest fractional part.
    ROUND_EACH: round every share HALF_UP, no correction (the sum may differ from the fee by a few cents).
    REST_TO_LARGEST / REST_TO_FIRST / REST_TO_LAST: round (or floor, see SetupPool.rest_base) every share, then the
    difference to the fee goes to the member with the largest weight / the first / the last member by tie order.
    """
    LARGEST_REMAINDER = "largest_remainder"
    ROUND_EACH = "round_each"
    REST_TO_LARGEST = "rest_to_largest"
    REST_TO_FIRST = "rest_to_first"
    REST_TO_LAST = "rest_to_last"


class TieOrder(StrEnum):
    ASCENDING = "ascending"
    DESCENDING = "descending"


class SetupPool(BaseModel):
    """Shared setup (Ruestpool): one fee split over members by final pieces x allocation mass."""
    fee: Decimal
    members: list[str]
    allocation: CentAllocation = CentAllocation.LARGEST_REMAINDER
    tie_order: TieOrder = Field(default=TieOrder.ASCENDING, description="Position order for ties and first/last")
    rest_base: Literal["half_up", "floor"] = "half_up"


class BonusBand(BaseModel):
    """Marginal band: percent applies to the part of the eligible total between lower and upper (None = open)."""
    lower: Decimal
    upper: Decimal | None = None
    percent: Decimal


class ProjectBonus(BaseModel):
    bands: list[BonusBand]
    members: list[str]
    include_surcharge: bool = Field(default=False, description="Assumption: goods value = pieces x EUR base price; "
                                                               "True adds the undiscounted mass surcharge")


class Approval(BaseModel):
    """The governing director approval (rules 5, 16)."""
    percent: Decimal
    min_order_value: Decimal | None = Field(default=None, description="Inclusive threshold in EUR, if conditional")


class PositionInput(BaseModel):
    position: str
    quantity: int = Field(ge=0, description="Final quantity in the stated unit (after Q&A changes, rule 1/13)")
    unit: Unit = Unit.PIECE
    pieces_per_set: int | None = Field(default=None, gt=0, description="From the governing spec, for Satz")
    material: Material | None = Field(default=None, description="None = no exactly matching active material")
    conditions: list[PriceCondition] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Candidates; calc picks the valid one")
    discount_scope: DiscountScope = DiscountScope.BASE_ONLY
    setup_fee: Decimal = Field(default=Decimal(0), description="Ordinary setup fee for the whole position, EUR")
    packaging: PackagingTariff | None = None
    commitment: DeliveryCommitment | None = None


class BidInput(BaseModel):
    tender_reference: str
    scenario_date: date
    positions: list[PositionInput]
    approval: Approval | None = None
    fx_rates: dict[str, Decimal] = Field(default_factory=dict, description="FX key (or currency) -> EUR per unit")
    metal_indices: dict[str, list[MetalIndexRate]] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    setup_pool: SetupPool | None = None
    project_bonus: ProjectBonus | None = None


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- output models


class AnswerPosition(BaseModel):
    position: str
    material_number: str
    quantity: int
    unit_price: Decimal
    lead_time_weeks: int
    base_unit_price: Decimal | None = None
    surcharge_per_unit: Decimal | None = None
    packaging_per_unit: Decimal | None = None
    rebate_total: Decimal | None = None


class PositionDebug(BaseModel):
    """Unrounded intermediates of one position."""
    position: str
    pieces: int
    pooled_demand: int
    scale_min_quantity: int
    scale_price: Decimal
    currency: str
    fx_rate: Decimal
    base_eur: Decimal
    metal_rate: Decimal
    mass_surcharge: Decimal
    discount_factor_base: Decimal
    discount_factor_surcharge: Decimal
    setup_fee: Decimal
    pool_allocation: Decimal
    cartons: int
    carton_cost: Decimal
    bonus: Decimal
    unit_price_exact: Decimal


class BidResult(BaseModel):
    tender_reference: str
    decision: Literal["bid", "no_bid"]
    currency: Literal["EUR"] = "EUR"
    discount_percent: Decimal
    positions: list[AnswerPosition]
    total_net: Decimal
    order_value: Decimal | None = Field(default=None, description="Undiscounted value for the discount threshold")
    bonus_total: Decimal | None = None
    missing_materials: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    debug: list[PositionDebug] = Field(default_factory=list)

    def answer(self, notes: str | None = None) -> dict:
        """The answer object per the answer schema, money as floats with two decimals."""
        out = {
            "tender_reference": self.tender_reference,
            "decision": self.decision,
            "currency": "EUR",
            "discount_percent": float(self.discount_percent),
            "positions": [{k: float(v) if isinstance(v, Decimal) else v
                           for k, v in p.model_dump().items() if v is not None} for p in self.positions],
            "total_net": float(self.total_net),
        }
        if notes:
            out["notes"] = notes[:4000]
        return out


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- mechanical selection helpers


class QuantityChange(BaseModel):
    number: str = Field(description="Q&A answer number")
    date: datetime
    position: str
    quantity: int


def resolve_quantity(tender_quantity: int, position: str, changes: list[QuantityChange], withdrawn: set[str],
                     scenario_date: date | None = None) -> int:
    """Rules 1 and 13: latest non-withdrawn change for the position (not future-dated), else the tender quantity."""
    live = [c for c in changes if c.position == position and c.number not in withdrawn
            and (scenario_date is None or _day(c.date) <= scenario_date)]
    if not live:
        return tender_quantity
    return max(live, key=lambda c: (c.date, position_key(c.number))).quantity


def to_pieces(quantity: int, unit: Unit, pieces_per_set: int | None) -> int:
    """Rule 17: Satz x pieces per set; pieces stay as they are."""
    if unit is Unit.PIECE:
        return quantity
    if not pieces_per_set:
        raise CalcError("quantity in sets but pieces per set unknown")
    return quantity * pieces_per_set


class Amendment(BaseModel):
    """A scoped technical amendment from the tender Q&A (rule 14)."""
    date: datetime
    revision: str
    requirement: str
    attributes: dict[str, Decimal | str]


def apply_amendments(attributes: dict[str, Decimal | str], amendments: list[Amendment], revision: str,
                     requirement: str, scenario_date: date | None = None) -> dict[str, Decimal | str]:
    """Rule 14: only amendments naming this revision and requirement; the latest dated one wins per attribute."""
    result = dict(attributes)
    latest: dict[str, datetime] = {}
    for a in amendments:
        if a.revision != revision or a.requirement != requirement:
            continue
        if scenario_date is not None and _day(a.date) > scenario_date:
            continue
        for key, value in a.attributes.items():
            if key not in latest or a.date >= latest[key]:
                latest[key] = a.date
                result[key] = value
    return result


def nominal_stroke(usable_stroke: Decimal, reserve_per_end: Decimal) -> Decimal:
    """Rule 20: nominal stroke = usable stroke (after amendments) + 2 x per-end reserve."""
    return usable_stroke + 2 * reserve_per_end


MATCH_KEYS = ("bore", "stroke", "pressure", "mounting", "certification")


def _same(a: Decimal | str, b: Decimal | str) -> bool:
    try:
        return Decimal(str(a)) == Decimal(str(b))
    except ArithmeticError:
        return " ".join(str(a).split()).casefold() == " ".join(str(b).split()).casefold()


def matching_materials(requirement: dict[str, Decimal | str], candidates: list[tuple[str, dict[str, Decimal | str]]],
                       keys: tuple[str, ...] = MATCH_KEYS) -> list[str]:
    """Rule 3: material numbers whose listed attributes all equal the requirement (numbers compared as numbers)."""
    return [number for number, attrs in candidates
            if all(k in attrs and k in requirement and _same(attrs[k], requirement[k]) for k in keys)]


class DatedRecord(BaseModel):
    """An authority record (mail) reduced to what rule 21 checks."""
    reference: str
    sender: str
    date: datetime
    key: str = ""


def latest_authoritative[R: DatedRecord](records: list[R], reference: str, scenario_date: date, sender_local: str,
                                         bidder_domain: str) -> R | None:
    """Rule 21: latest record for the exact reference from local@domain, dated no later than the scenario date."""
    sender = f"{sender_local}@{bidder_domain}".casefold()
    ok = [r for r in records if r.reference.strip() == reference.strip() and r.sender.strip().casefold() == sender
          and _day(r.date) <= scenario_date]
    return max(ok, key=lambda r: r.date) if ok else None


def valid_condition(conditions: list[PriceCondition], on: date) -> PriceCondition:
    """Rule 4: the condition whose inclusive validity contains the date (latest start if several)."""
    valid = [c for c in conditions if c.valid_from <= on and (c.valid_to is None or on <= c.valid_to)]
    if not valid:
        raise CalcError(f"no price condition valid on {on}")
    return max(valid, key=lambda c: c.valid_from)


def reached_scale(scales: list[PriceScale], pieces: int) -> PriceScale:
    """Rule 4: the highest scale whose minimum the pieces reach (per position, never the material sum)."""
    reached = [s for s in scales if s.min_quantity <= pieces]
    if not reached:
        raise CalcError(f"no price scale reached by {pieces} pieces")
    return max(reached, key=lambda s: s.min_quantity)


def metal_rate(rates: list[MetalIndexRate], on: date) -> Decimal:
    """Rule 28: the rate whose inclusive window contains the date; a single unwindowed rate applies as is."""
    hits = [r for r in rates
            if (r.valid_from is None or r.valid_from <= on) and (r.valid_to is None or on <= r.valid_to)]
    if not hits:
        raise CalcError(f"no metal index rate valid on {on}")
    windowed = [r for r in hits if r.valid_from is not None or r.valid_to is not None]
    return (windowed or hits)[-1].rate


def bonus_credit(total: Decimal, bands: list[BonusBand]) -> Decimal:
    """Rule 26: each band's percent on its own portion of the total, aggregate rounded HALF_UP to cents."""
    credit = Decimal(0)
    for band in bands:
        top = total if band.upper is None else min(total, band.upper)
        if top > band.lower:
            credit += (top - band.lower) * band.percent / HUNDRED
    return money(credit)


def allocate_cents(amount: Decimal, weights: dict[str, Decimal],
                   method: CentAllocation = CentAllocation.LARGEST_REMAINDER, tie_order: TieOrder = TieOrder.ASCENDING,
                   rest_base: Literal["half_up", "floor"] = "half_up") -> dict[str, Decimal]:
    """
    Split an amount (rounded to cents first) over positions proportionally to weights, in whole cents.

    Ties (equal remainders or equal weights) go by position order, ascending unless tie_order says otherwise.
    """
    total_weight = sum(weights.values(), Decimal(0))
    if not weights or total_weight <= 0:
        raise CalcError("allocation needs positive weights")
    cents = int(money(amount) / CENT)
    order = sorted(weights, key=position_key, reverse=tie_order is TieOrder.DESCENDING)
    exact = {p: Decimal(cents) * weights[p] / total_weight for p in order}
    if method is CentAllocation.LARGEST_REMAINDER:
        share = {p: int(exact[p].to_integral_value(ROUND_FLOOR)) for p in order}
        left = cents - sum(share.values())
        ranked = sorted(order, key=lambda p: exact[p] - share[p], reverse=True)  # stable: ties keep position order
        for p in ranked[:left]:
            share[p] += 1
    else:
        rounding = ROUND_FLOOR if (method is not CentAllocation.ROUND_EACH and rest_base == "floor") else ROUND_HALF_UP
        share = {p: int(exact[p].to_integral_value(rounding)) for p in order}
        if method is not CentAllocation.ROUND_EACH:
            target = {CentAllocation.REST_TO_FIRST: order[0], CentAllocation.REST_TO_LAST: order[-1],
                      CentAllocation.REST_TO_LARGEST: max(order, key=lambda p: weights[p])}[method]
            share[target] += cents - sum(share.values())
    return {p: Decimal(c) * CENT for p, c in share.items()}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the calculation


def _base_eur(pos: PositionInput, pieces: int, bid: BidInput) -> tuple[Decimal, PriceScale, PriceCondition, Decimal]:
    """Rule 22: price unit normalised, per-position scale, EUR per currency unit, HALF_UP to cents."""
    cond = valid_condition(pos.conditions, bid.scenario_date)
    scale = reached_scale(cond.scales, pieces)
    if cond.currency.upper() == "EUR":
        fx = Decimal(1)
    else:
        key = cond.fx_key or cond.currency
        if key not in bid.fx_rates and cond.currency not in bid.fx_rates:
            raise CalcError(f"no FX rate for {key}")
        fx = bid.fx_rates.get(key, bid.fx_rates.get(cond.currency))
    return money(scale.price / Decimal(cond.price_unit) * fx), scale, cond, fx


def _metal_rate(material: Material, bid: BidInput) -> Decimal:
    if material.surcharge_mass == 0:
        return Decimal(0)
    code = material.metal_index
    if code is None:
        if len(bid.metal_indices) != 1:
            raise CalcError(f"{material.material_number}: metal index code needed")
        code = next(iter(bid.metal_indices))
    if code not in bid.metal_indices:
        raise CalcError(f"no metal index {code}")
    return metal_rate(bid.metal_indices[code], bid.scenario_date)


def effective_discount(approval: Approval | None, order_value: Decimal | None) -> Decimal:
    """Rules 5 and 16: approved percent, or 0 when the inclusive threshold fails (or no value exists, as for no_bid)."""
    if approval is None:
        return Decimal(0)
    if approval.min_order_value is None:
        return approval.percent
    if order_value is None or order_value < approval.min_order_value:
        return Decimal(0)
    return approval.percent


def lead_time(pos: PositionInput, pooled_demand: int) -> int:
    """Rules 6, 15, 24: commitment if material matches and pooled demand is within its ceiling, else shared stock."""
    material = pos.material
    assert material is not None
    c = pos.commitment
    if c is not None and c.material_number == material.material_number and pooled_demand <= c.ceiling:
        return c.lead_time_weeks
    if material.free_stock >= pooled_demand:
        return material.stock_lead_time_weeks
    return material.production_lead_time_weeks


def calculate(bid: BidInput) -> BidResult:
    """Apply the bid rules to established facts and return the answer with intermediates."""
    missing = [p.position for p in bid.positions if p.material is None]
    if missing:
        return BidResult(tender_reference=bid.tender_reference, decision="no_bid", positions=[],
                         discount_percent=effective_discount(bid.approval, None), total_net=Decimal("0.00"),
                         missing_materials=missing)

    pieces = {p.position: to_pieces(p.quantity, p.unit, p.pieces_per_set) for p in bid.positions}
    pooled: dict[str, int] = defaultdict(int)
    for p in bid.positions:
        pooled[p.material.material_number] += pieces[p.position]  # type: ignore[union-attr]

    base: dict[str, tuple[Decimal, PriceScale, PriceCondition, Decimal]] = {
        p.position: _base_eur(p, pieces[p.position], bid) for p in bid.positions}
    rates = {p.position: _metal_rate(p.material, bid) for p in bid.positions}  # type: ignore[arg-type]
    surcharge = {p.position: p.material.surcharge_mass * rates[p.position] for p in bid.positions}  # type: ignore

    order_value = money(sum((pieces[k] * base[k][0] for k in pieces), Decimal(0)))
    discount = effective_discount(bid.approval, order_value)
    factor = 1 - discount / HUNDRED

    pool: dict[str, Decimal] = {}
    if bid.setup_pool is not None:
        by_pos = {p.position: p for p in bid.positions}
        weights = {m: pieces[m] * by_pos[m].material.allocation_mass  # type: ignore[union-attr]
                   for m in bid.setup_pool.members if m in by_pos}
        if weights:
            pool = allocate_cents(bid.setup_pool.fee, weights, bid.setup_pool.allocation, bid.setup_pool.tie_order,
                                  bid.setup_pool.rest_base)

    bonus: dict[str, Decimal] = {}
    bonus_total = None
    if bid.project_bonus is not None:
        goods = {}
        for p in bid.positions:
            if p.position in bid.project_bonus.members:
                unit = base[p.position][0] + (surcharge[p.position] if bid.project_bonus.include_surcharge else 0)
                goods[p.position] = pieces[p.position] * unit
        bonus_total = bonus_credit(money(sum(goods.values(), Decimal(0))), bid.project_bonus.bands)
        if goods and bonus_total > 0:
            bonus = allocate_cents(bonus_total, goods)

    positions, debug = [], []
    for p in bid.positions:
        k, material, n = p.position, p.material, pieces[p.position]
        assert material is not None
        base_eur, scale, cond, fx = base[k]
        f_base = factor if p.discount_scope is not DiscountScope.NONE else Decimal(1)
        f_sur = factor if p.discount_scope is DiscountScope.BASE_AND_SURCHARGE else Decimal(1)
        if n == 0:
            raise CalcError(f"{k}: zero pieces")
        cartons, carton_cost = 0, Decimal(0)
        if p.packaging is not None:
            if not material.pieces_per_carton:
                raise CalcError(f"{k}: carton size unknown")
            cartons = math.ceil(n / material.pieces_per_carton)
            carton_cost = cartons * p.packaging.price_per_carton
        setup = p.setup_fee + pool.get(k, Decimal(0))
        credit = bonus.get(k, Decimal(0))
        exact = base_eur * f_base + surcharge[k] * f_sur + (setup + carton_cost - credit) / n
        positions.append(AnswerPosition(
            position=k, material_number=material.material_number, quantity=n, unit_price=money(exact),
            lead_time_weeks=lead_time(p, pooled[material.material_number]), base_unit_price=base_eur,
            surcharge_per_unit=money(surcharge[k] + setup / n), packaging_per_unit=money(carton_cost / n),
            rebate_total=money(credit)))
        debug.append(PositionDebug(
            position=k, pieces=n, pooled_demand=pooled[material.material_number], scale_min_quantity=scale.min_quantity,
            scale_price=scale.price, currency=cond.currency, fx_rate=fx, base_eur=base_eur, metal_rate=rates[k],
            mass_surcharge=surcharge[k], discount_factor_base=f_base, discount_factor_surcharge=f_sur,
            setup_fee=p.setup_fee, pool_allocation=pool.get(k, Decimal(0)), cartons=cartons, carton_cost=carton_cost,
            bonus=credit, unit_price_exact=exact))

    total = money(sum((p.quantity * p.unit_price for p in positions), Decimal(0)))
    return BidResult(tender_reference=bid.tender_reference, decision="bid", discount_percent=discount,
                     positions=positions, total_net=total, order_value=order_value, bonus_total=bonus_total,
                     debug=debug)

"""
Evidence records the research workers produce, and their mapping onto calc's input models.

Workers copy values exactly as the pages show them (raw strings, which the grounding check can verify); the parsing
here is deterministic: locale-tagged numbers ("1.234,50 (de-DE)", "12,345 (en-US)"), dates in several orders,
masses with units, lead times in weeks. Exact attribute matching is a validator over the model-collected facts.
"""
import re
from datetime import date
from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

import calc

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- parsing


class ParseError(ValueError):
    pass


_TAG = re.compile(r"\(\s*([a-z]{2})[-_]([A-Z]{2})\s*\)")
_NUM = re.compile(r"[-+]?\d[\d.,'   ]*")


def number_format(text: str, fallback: str | None = None) -> str | None:
    """The locale a value is written in: its own tag "(de-DE)", else the fallback (e.g. the record's format)."""
    tag = _TAG.search(text or "")
    if tag:
        return tag.group(1).lower()
    if fallback:
        m = re.search(r"([a-z]{2})(?:[-_][A-Za-z]{2})?", fallback.strip(), re.IGNORECASE)
        return m.group(1).lower() if m else None
    return None


def parse_number(text: str, fmt: str | None = None) -> Decimal:
    """
    A number as a page writes it. `fmt` is a language code or locale ("de", "en-US") when the text carries no tag.

    Without any format: both separators -> the last one is decimal; a single comma or dot followed by exactly three
    digits is a thousands separator only for "en"/"de" respectively, otherwise German pages default to comma decimal.
    """
    if text is None:
        raise ParseError("no value")
    lang = number_format(text, fmt)
    body = _TAG.sub("", str(text))
    m = _NUM.search(body)
    if not m:
        raise ParseError(f"no number in {text!r}")
    raw = re.sub(r"['   ]", "", m.group(0)).rstrip(".,")
    if lang == "en":
        raw = raw.replace(",", "")
    elif lang in ("de", "fr", "es", "it", "nl", "pt"):
        raw = raw.replace(".", "").replace(",", ".")
    elif "," in raw and "." in raw:
        if raw.rfind(",") > raw.rfind("."):
            raw = raw.replace(".", "").replace(",", ".")
        else:
            raw = raw.replace(",", "")
    elif "," in raw:
        raw = raw.replace(",", ".") if raw.count(",") == 1 else raw.replace(",", "")
    elif raw.count(".") > 1:
        raw = raw.replace(".", "")
    try:
        return Decimal(raw)
    except InvalidOperation as error:
        raise ParseError(f"cannot read {text!r}") from error


def parse_int(text: str, fmt: str | None = None) -> int:
    value = parse_number(text, fmt)
    if value != value.to_integral_value():
        raise ParseError(f"{text!r} is not a whole number")
    return int(value)


_DATE_TAG = re.compile(r"\((MM|TT|DD)[/.-](TT|DD|MM)\)", re.IGNORECASE)


def parse_date(text: str) -> date:
    """
    A date as shown: ISO "2027-01-25", German "25.01.2027", or slashed "01/25/2027" / "25/01/2027" with an optional
    order tag "(MM/TT)" / "(TT/MM)" that may stand between day-month and year ("21/03 (TT/MM) 2030").
    Untagged slashed dates are read day first unless that is impossible.
    """
    t = str(text)
    m = re.search(r"(\d{4})-(\d{1,2})-(\d{1,2})", t)
    if m:
        return date(int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2)), int(m.group(3)))
    m = re.search(r"(\d{1,2})\.(\d{1,2})\.(\d{4})", t)
    if m:
        return date(int(m.group(3)), int(m.group(2)), int(m.group(1)))
    m = re.search(r"(\d{1,2})/(\d{1,2})(?:/|\s*(?:\([^)]*\))?\s*)(\d{4})", t)
    if m:

        tag = _DATE_TAG.search(t)

def number_format(text: str, fallback: str | None = None) -> str | None:

"""
Tender research: the tender's positions with their original quantities, and everything the bidder Q&A changes.

A navigation worker (thinking off, so steps are fast) finds the tender on the bid website, picks the documents
that hold the bill of quantities and hands their links to `keep_pages`, which opens them and keeps their text. On
the bidder Q&A it hands the list's "next page" (or "load more") control to `collect_pages`, which pages through
that model-selected result set. Two readers (thinking on) then turn the kept pages into typed records, checked
against the pages, and `resolve_tender` applies the mechanical rules (latest dated answer per position and key,
withdrawn answers ignored, nothing after the scenario date) in calc's terms.
"""
import asyncio
import re
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
from typing import Literal
from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlparse

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from pydantic_ai import Agent, ModelRetry, RunContext
from pydantic_ai.models.openai import OpenAIChatModel
from pydantic_ai.providers.openai import OpenAIProvider

import llm
from browser_tools import Deps, SiteSession, _click
from calc import (
    Amendment,
    QuantityChange,
    Unit,
    parse_unit,
    position_key,
    resolve_quantity,
)
from worker import run_worker

MAX_PAGES = 40
MAX_RETURN = 30000  # characters of a collected list shown back to the model
READER_TIMEOUT = 180.0  # a thinking reader writes long answers; the navigation timeout is too short

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- records


class TenderPosition(BaseModel):
    position: str = Field(description="Position number exactly as written, e.g. with its dots and leading zeros")
    short_text: str = Field(description="The position's short text")
    quantity: int = Field(description="ORIGINAL quantity from the tender documents, in the stated unit")
    unit: str = Field(description="Unit exactly as written")
    requirement: str = Field(description="Requirement id the position refers to in the buyer's specification")


class TenderPositions(BaseModel):
    positions: list[TenderPosition]


class Summary(BaseModel):
    summary: str = Field(description="One or two sentences on what you kept")


class QaRef(BaseModel):
    answer_number: str = Field(description="The answer's number (Nr.) exactly as shown")
    date: datetime = Field(description="The answer's date as an ISO 8601 timestamp; prefer the UTC value the page "
                                       "shows (ending in Z), else the local time with its offset")


class QaQuantityChange(QaRef):
    position: str
    quantity: int = Field(description="The new total quantity, in the position's stated unit")
    unit: str = Field(default="", description="Unit the answer states, if any")


class QaWithdrawal(QaRef):
    withdrawn_number: str = Field(description="Number of the earlier answer this answer withdraws (zurückziehen)")


class QaKey(QaRef):
    position: str
    key: str = Field(description="The key exactly as written, e.g. a group, tariff or plan identifier")


class QaSetupFee(QaRef):
    position: str
    amount_eur: Decimal = Field(description="The ordinary one-off setup fee for the whole position, "
                                            "net EUR, as a plain decimal number")


AttributeName = Literal["bore", "stroke", "pressure", "mounting", "certification", "pieces_per_set", "other"]


class QaAmendment(QaRef):
    revision: str = Field(description="Specification revision the amendment names, exactly as written")
    requirement: str = Field(description="Requirement id the amendment names")
    attribute: AttributeName = Field(description="Which attribute it changes: bore, stroke (including a "
                                                 "usable stroke / nutzbarer Weg), pressure, mounting, certification, "
                                                 "pieces_per_set, or other")
    attribute_label: str = Field(description="The attribute's name as written")
    value: str = Field(description="The new value as written, without its unit")
    unit: str = Field(default="", description="The value's unit, if any (e.g. mm, bar)")


class QaRecords(BaseModel):
    """Every fact the bidder Q&A states, one record per answer and fact (an answer can carry several)."""
    quantity_changes: list[QaQuantityChange] = Field(default_factory=list)
    withdrawals: list[QaWithdrawal] = Field(default_factory=list)
    condition_groups: list[QaKey] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Konditionsgruppe per position")
    packaging_tariffs: list[QaKey] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Packaging tariff key per position")
    delivery_commitments: list[QaKey] = Field(default_factory=list,
                                              description="Delivery commitment (Termin) key per position")
    setup_pools: list[QaKey] = Field(default_factory=list,
                                     description="Shared setup pool (Rüstpool) a position is a member of")
    project_bonuses: list[QaKey] = Field(default_factory=list,
                                         description="Project bonus plan a position is a member of")
    setup_fees: list[QaSetupFee] = Field(default_factory=list)
    amendments: list[QaAmendment] = Field(default_factory=list,
                                          description="Technical amendments, one record per changed attribute")


class PositionFacts(BaseModel):
    """One position after the Q&A rules, ready to map onto calc.PositionInput."""
    position: str
    short_text: str
    requirement: str
    unit: Unit
    unit_text: str
    tender_quantity: int
    quantity: int = Field(description="Final quantity in the stated unit (rules 1, 13)")
    quantity_answer: str | None = Field(default=None, description="Q&A answer number that set it, None = tender")
    condition_group: str | None = None
    packaging_key: str | None = None
    commitment_key: str | None = None
    setup_pool_key: str | None = None
    bonus_key: str | None = None
    setup_fee: Decimal = Decimal(0)


class TenderFacts(BaseModel):
    positions: list[PositionFacts]
    amendments: list[Amendment] = Field(default_factory=list, description="For calc.apply_amendments (rule 14)")
    amendment_units: dict[str, str] = Field(default_factory=dict, description="attribute -> unit as written")
    withdrawn: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    qa: QaRecords
    seconds: float = 0.0


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the paging helper


REF_LINE = re.compile(r'\[(e\d+) (\w+) "([^"]*)"')
REFS = re.compile(r"\be\d+\b")
REF = re.compile(r"e\d+")
LINK = re.compile(r'\[(e\d+) link "[^"]*" -> ([^\]\s]+)\]')
EMPTY_FRAME = re.compile(r"\[frame ([^\]\s]+)\]\n\[/frame\]")


def _normal(view: str) -> str:
    return REFS.sub("", view)


@dataclass
class Collected:
    pages: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    def add(self, view: str) -> bool:
        """Keep a page view; False when it adds nothing new (past the end a list repeats a page it showed)."""
        new = _normal(view)
        earlier = [_normal(p) for p in self.pages]
        if new in earlier:
            return False
        if earlier and set(earlier[-1].splitlines()) <= set(new.splitlines()):  # "load more" grew the list
            self.pages[-1] = view
            return True
        self.pages.append(view)
        return True

    @property
    def text(self) -> str:
        return "\n\n".join(f"=== page view {i + 1}\n{p}" for i, p in enumerate(self.pages))


def _control(view: str, ref: str) -> tuple[str, str] | None:
    for r, kind, name in REF_LINE.findall(view):
        if r == ref:
            return kind, name
    return None


def paging_tool(collected: Collected):
    """A tool that pages through the result set the model is looking at, by repeating the control it names."""

    async def collect_pages(ctx: RunContext[Deps], next_ref: str) -> str:
        """Collect the whole list you are looking at: give the ref of its "next page" or "load more" control. The
        control is clicked until the list ends; every page is kept for reading afterwards. Call it once, on the
        list's first page."""
        session: SiteSession = ctx.deps.session
        control = _control(session.view, next_ref)
        if control is None:
            return f"No control {next_ref} in the latest view; use a ref from the latest view."
        kind, name = control
        collected.add(session.view)
        ref, pages = next_ref, 1
        for _ in range(MAX_PAGES):
            view = await session.act("click", ref, _click)
            if not collected.add(session.view):
                break
            pages += 1
            same = [r for r, k, n in REF_LINE.findall(session.view) if k == kind and n == name]
            if not same:
                break
            ref = same[0]
        session.trace.event(session.name, "collect_pages", control=name, pages=len(collected.pages))
        text = collected.text
        if len(text) > MAX_RETURN:
            text = text[:MAX_RETURN] + f"\n[... {len(text) - MAX_RETURN} more characters, kept for reading]"
        return f"Collected {pages} page(s) of this list; they are kept for reading. The whole list:\n\n{text}"

    return collect_pages


def keep_tool(kept: list[str], name: str = "keep_pages"):
    """A tool that opens link targets the model chose, each in a temporary tab, and keeps their page text."""

    async def keep_pages(ctx: RunContext[Deps], targets: list[str]) -> str:
        """Open these links and keep each page for reading afterwards: give each link's target (the "-> ..." part)
        or its ref from the latest view. Pass every page you want at once; they open side by side. Your own tab
        stays where it is."""
        session: SiteSession = ctx.deps.session
        host = urlparse(session.site["url"]).netloc
        def on_a_page(target: str) -> bool:  # chosen from a view, not made up
            url = urlparse(urljoin(session.page.url, target))
            local = url.path + (f"?{url.query}" if url.query else "")
            return target in session.seen or f"-> {local}" in session.seen or f"-> {url.geturl()}" in session.seen

        links = LINK.findall(session.view)
        hrefs = dict(links)  # a link's ref from the latest view stands for its target
        targets = [hrefs.get(t.strip(), t.strip()) for t in targets]
        shown = [t for t in targets if t and not REF.fullmatch(t) and on_a_page(t)]
        unknown = [t for t in targets if t.strip() and t.strip() not in shown]
        urls = list(dict.fromkeys(urljoin(session.page.url, t) for t in shown))
        urls = [u for u in urls if urlparse(u).netloc == host][:25]

        async def one(url: str) -> str:
            tab = SiteSession(session.site, session.context, session.trace)
            page = await session.context.new_page()
            tab._watch(page)
            try:
                await tab._goto(url)
                view = await tab.look()
                # An embedded document that did not render in place (e.g. a lazy reading pane) is part of the
                # chosen page: open it on its own and add its text.
                for src in EMPTY_FRAME.findall(view)[:3]:
                    await tab._goto(urljoin(url, src))
                    view += f"\n[frame {src} opened]\n" + await tab.look()
                return view
            finally:
                await page.close()

        views = await asyncio.gather(*(one(u) for u in urls), return_exceptions=True)
        good = [v for v in views if isinstance(v, str)]
        for view in good:
            kept.append(view)
            session.seen += "\n" + view
        session.trace.event(session.name, name, targets=urls, unknown=unknown, kept=len(good))
        heads = [" / ".join(line for line in v.splitlines()[:2]) for v in good]
        answer = f"Kept {len(good)} of {len(urls)} page(s):\n" + "\n".join(f"- {h}" for h in heads)
        if unknown:
            listing = "\n".join(f"  {ref}: {href}" for ref, href in links[:40])
            answer += (f"\nNot opened, these targets appear on no page you have seen: {unknown[:10]}. Use link "
                       f"targets exactly as the views show them. Links in the latest view:\n{listing}")
        return answer

    keep_pages.__name__ = name
    return keep_pages


def _goal(reference: str) -> str:
    return f"""For tender {reference} (exactly this reference; similar references are other tenders):
1. Open this tender and its list of documents. Call keep_pages once with the link targets of the documents that
   can hold the positions (bill of quantities / position list with the original quantities, and the description).
   Ignore buttons and links that lead elsewhere (surveys, tools). Do not open the documents yourself.
2. Open the tender's bidder questions and answers (Q&A). When the list of answers shows, call collect_pages with
   the ref of the list's control for the next page (or for loading more). Do not page through it yourself.
3. Then return a short summary. Do not open or start the bid submission. To move between pages follow links or
   goto a link target; do not use back(). You need not note() anything: the kept
   pages are read for you."""


POSITIONS_INSTRUCTIONS = """\
You read the documents of a public tender (German) and list its positions exactly as written: position number,
short text, quantity, unit and the requirement id of the buyer's specification the position refers to. Use the
ORIGINAL quantities the tender documents were published with; later changes are not part of this. If several documents list the positions, they should agree; prefer a table of the bill of
quantities. List every position once."""


QA_INSTRUCTIONS = """\
You read the bidder Q&A of a public tender (German) and record every fact it states, exactly as written.
The answers may be shown out of number order (sorted by date); each answer has a number and a date. Use the
answer's own date (prefer the UTC timestamp shown, e.g. in a tooltip). One answer can carry several facts: record
each of them, with that answer's number and date. Record what the answers say; do not resolve conflicts, do not
skip older or superseded answers, and do not invent facts for positions an answer does not name. Statements that
a position is NOT a member of a pool or plan mean no membership: record nothing for them. An answer that withdraws
(zieht zurück) an earlier answer is a withdrawal of that earlier answer's number. Technical amendments name a
specification revision and a requirement: record one amendment per changed attribute. The same answer can appear
on two page views; record it once. Ignore page furniture (navigation, notices, buttons)."""


def _numbers(text: str) -> set[Decimal]:
    found: set[Decimal] = set()
    for token in re.findall(r"\d[\d.,]*", text):
        token = token.rstrip(".,")
        for candidate in (token.replace(",", "."), token.replace(".", "").replace(",", "."), token.replace(",", "")):
            try:
                found.add(Decimal(candidate))
            except InvalidOperation:
                pass
    return found


def ungrounded(record: BaseModel, text: str, skip: tuple[str, ...] = ("date",)) -> list[str]:
    """Values in a record (numbers, keys) that the source text does not contain; dates are not checked."""
    numbers = _numbers(text)
    flat = " ".join(text.split())
    missing: list[str] = []

    def check(value, name: str) -> None:
        if name in skip or value is None or isinstance(value, (bool, datetime)):
            return
        if isinstance(value, BaseModel):
            for k, v in value:
                check(v, k)
        elif isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
            for v in value:
                check(v, name)
        elif isinstance(value, dict):
            for k, v in value.items():
                check(v, str(k))
        elif isinstance(value, (int, Decimal, float)):
            if Decimal(str(value)) not in numbers:
                missing.append(f"{name}={value}")
        elif isinstance(value, str) and any(c.isdigit() for c in value):
            if " ".join(value.split()) not in flat and not (_numbers(value) and _numbers(value) <= numbers):
                missing.append(f"{name}={value!r}")

    check(record, "")
    return missing


def reader_model():
    """The run's model with a longer timeout, for thinking readers that write long typed answers."""
    base = llm.model()
    return OpenAIChatModel(base.model_name, provider=OpenAIProvider(
        openai_client=base.client.with_options(timeout=READER_TIMEOUT, max_retries=2)))


async def _read(output_type, instructions: str, text: str, prompt: str):
    agent = Agent(reader_model(), output_type=output_type, instructions=instructions,
                  model_settings=llm.settings(thinking=True), retries=3)

    @agent.output_validator
    def _grounded(records):
        missing = ungrounded(records, text)
        if missing:
            raise ModelRetry(f"These values are not in the pages: {', '.join(missing[:12])}. Copy values exactly.")
        return records

    return (await agent.run(f"{prompt}\n\n{text}")).output


async def read_positions(text: str, reference: str) -> list[TenderPosition]:
    found = await _read(TenderPositions, POSITIONS_INSTRUCTIONS, text, f"Tender {reference}. Documents:")
    return found.positions


async def read_qa(pages: list[str], reference: str) -> QaRecords:
    """Each page view read on its own, in parallel (short answers, fast), then merged without duplicates."""
    parts = await asyncio.gather(*(_read(QaRecords, QA_INSTRUCTIONS, page, f"Tender {reference}. Bidder Q&A page:")
                                   for page in pages))
    merged = QaRecords()
    for name in QaRecords.model_fields:
        seen: dict[str, BaseModel] = {}
        for part in parts:
            for record in getattr(part, name):
                seen.setdefault(record.model_dump_json(), record)
        setattr(merged, name, list(seen.values()))
    return merged


async def research_tender(session: SiteSession, reference: str, scenario: datetime, *,
                          deadline: float | None = None) -> TenderFacts | None:
    """Positions and Q&A of the tender, resolved per position. None when no positions were found."""
    started = time.monotonic()
    collected = Collected()
    documents: list[str] = []
    _, notes = await run_worker(session, _goal(reference), Summary, deadline=deadline, max_steps=20,
                                thinking=False, grounded=False,
                                tools=(paging_tool(collected), keep_tool(documents)))
    if not documents:  # the worker read the documents in its own tab instead
        documents = [session.seen]
    qa_pages = collected.pages or [session.seen]  # without collect_pages: the answers it saw itself
    positions, qa = await asyncio.gather(read_positions("\n\n".join(documents), reference),
                                         read_qa(qa_pages, reference))
    if not positions:
        session.trace.event(session.name, "tender_failed", notes=notes)
        return None
    facts = resolve_tender(positions, qa, scenario)
    facts.seconds = round(time.monotonic() - started, 1)
    session.trace.event(session.name, "tender_facts", seconds=facts.seconds,
                        positions=[p.model_dump(mode="json") for p in facts.positions])
    return facts


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the mechanical rules


def _same_ref(a: str, b: str) -> bool:
    return a.strip().casefold() == b.strip().casefold()


def _latest_key(records: list[QaKey], position: str, withdrawn: set[str], scenario: datetime) -> str | None:
    live = [r for r in records if _same_ref(r.position, position) and r.answer_number not in withdrawn
            and _aware(r.date) <= scenario]
    return max(live, key=lambda r: (_aware(r.date), position_key(r.answer_number))).key if live else None


def _aware(value: datetime) -> datetime:
    return value if value.tzinfo else value.replace(tzinfo=UTC)


def _decimal_or_text(value: str) -> Decimal | str:
    try:
        return Decimal(value.strip().replace(" ", "").replace(",", "."))
    except InvalidOperation:
        return value.strip()


def resolve_tender(positions: list[TenderPosition], qa: QaRecords, scenario: datetime) -> TenderFacts:
    """Rules 1, 13, 14 and the Q&A keys: latest dated answer per position and key, withdrawn ones ignored."""
    scenario = _aware(scenario)
    withdrawn = {w.withdrawn_number for w in qa.withdrawals if _aware(w.date) <= scenario}
    changes = [QuantityChange(number=c.answer_number, date=_aware(c.date), position=c.position, quantity=c.quantity)
               for c in qa.quantity_changes if _aware(c.date) <= scenario]
    facts = []
    for p in sorted(positions, key=lambda p: position_key(p.position)):
        mine = [c for c in changes if _same_ref(c.position, p.position)]
        for c in mine:
            c.position = p.position
        final = resolve_quantity(p.quantity, p.position, mine, withdrawn, scenario.date())
        live = [c for c in mine if c.number not in withdrawn]
        source = max(live, key=lambda c: (c.date, position_key(c.number))).number if live else None
        fees = [f for f in qa.setup_fees if _same_ref(f.position, p.position) and f.answer_number not in withdrawn
                and _aware(f.date) <= scenario]
        fee = max(fees, key=lambda f: _aware(f.date)).amount_eur if fees else Decimal(0)
        facts.append(PositionFacts(
            position=p.position, short_text=p.short_text, requirement=p.requirement, unit=parse_unit(p.unit),
            unit_text=p.unit, tender_quantity=p.quantity, quantity=final, quantity_answer=source,
            condition_group=_latest_key(qa.condition_groups, p.position, withdrawn, scenario),
            packaging_key=_latest_key(qa.packaging_tariffs, p.position, withdrawn, scenario),
            commitment_key=_latest_key(qa.delivery_commitments, p.position, withdrawn, scenario),
            setup_pool_key=_latest_key(qa.setup_pools, p.position, withdrawn, scenario),
            bonus_key=_latest_key(qa.project_bonuses, p.position, withdrawn, scenario),
            setup_fee=fee))
    amendments = [Amendment(date=_aware(a.date), revision=a.revision, requirement=a.requirement,
                            attributes={a.attribute if a.attribute != "other" else a.attribute_label:
                                        _decimal_or_text(a.value)})
                  for a in qa.amendments if a.answer_number not in withdrawn and _aware(a.date) <= scenario]
    units = {a.attribute: a.unit for a in qa.amendments if a.unit}
    return TenderFacts(positions=facts, amendments=amendments, amendment_units=units, withdrawn=sorted(withdrawn),
                       qa=qa)

    quantity: int = Field(description="ORIGINAL quantity from the tender documents, in the stated unit")
    unit: str = Field(description="Unit exactly as written")
    requirement: str = Field(description="Requirement id the position refers to in the buyer's specification")


class TenderPositions(BaseModel):
    positions: list[TenderPosition]


class Summary(BaseModel):
    summary: str = Field(description="One or two sentences on what you kept")


class QaRef(BaseModel):
    answer_number: str = Field(description="The answer's number (Nr.) exactly as shown")
    date: datetime = Field(description="The answer's date as an ISO 8601 timestamp; prefer the UTC value the page "
                                       "shows (ending in Z), else the local time with its offset")


class QaQuantityChange(QaRef):
    position: str
    quantity: int = Field(description="The new total quantity, in the position's stated unit")
    unit: str = Field(default="", description="Unit the answer states, if any")


class QaWithdrawal(QaRef):
    withdrawn_number: str = Field(description="Number of the earlier answer this answer withdraws (zurückziehen)")


class QaKey(QaRef):
    position: str
    key: str = Field(description="The key exactly as written, e.g. a group, tariff or plan identifier")


class QaSetupFee(QaRef):

                                            "net EUR, as a plain decimal number")


AttributeName = Literal["bore", "stroke", "pressure", "mounting", "certification", "pieces_per_set", "other"]


class QaAmendment(QaRef):
    revision: str = Field(description="Specification revision the amendment names, exactly as written")
    requirement: str = Field(description="Requirement id the amendment names")

                                                 "usable stroke / nutzbarer Weg), pressure, mounting, certification, "
                                                 "pieces_per_set, or other")
    attribute_label: str = Field(description="The attribute's name as written")

    unit: str = Field(default="", description="The value's unit, if any (e.g. mm, bar)")


class QaRecords(BaseModel):
    """Every fact the bidder Q&A states, one record per answer and fact (an answer can carry several)."""
    quantity_changes: list[QaQuantityChange] = Field(default_factory=list)
    withdrawals: list[QaWithdrawal] = Field(default_factory=list)
    condition_groups: list[QaKey] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Konditionsgruppe per position")
    packaging_tariffs: list[QaKey] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Packaging tariff key per position")

                                              description="Delivery commitment (Termin) key per position")

                                     description="Shared setup pool (Rüstpool) a position is a member of")

                                         description="Project bonus plan a position is a member of")
    setup_fees: list[QaSetupFee] = Field(default_factory=list)
    amendments: list[QaAmendment] = Field(default_factory=list,
                                          description="Technical amendments, one record per changed attribute")


class PositionFacts(BaseModel):
    """One position after the Q&A rules, ready to map onto calc.PositionInput."""
    position: str
    short_text: str
    requirement: str
    unit: Unit
    unit_text: str
    tender_quantity: int
    quantity: int = Field(description="Final quantity in the stated unit (rules 1, 13)")
    quantity_answer: str | None = Field(default=None, description="Q&A answer number that set it, None = tender")
    condition_group: str | None = None
    packaging_key: str | None = None
    commitment_key: str | None = None
    setup_pool_key: str | None = None
