from research_mail import bid_clauses, plan_searches, research_mail  # noqa: E402
from research_tender import research_tender  # noqa: E402
from tracing import Trace  # noqa: E402


def scenario_time(text: str) -> datetime:
    value = datetime.fromisoformat(text.strip().replace("Z", "+00:00"))
    return value if value.tzinfo else value.replace(tzinfo=UTC)


def dump(title: str, model) -> None:
    print(f"\n===== {title}")
    print(json.dumps(model.model_dump(mode="json"), indent=1, ensure_ascii=False) if model is not None else "None")


async def main() -> None:
    parts = set(sys.argv[1:]) or {"tender", "mail"}
    task, _ = contract.load_run()
    trace = Trace()
    t0 = time.monotonic()
    briefing = await read_brief(task)
    t_brief = time.monotonic() - t0
    print(f"brief: {briefing.tender_reference} {briefing.scenario_date} bid={briefing.bid_site} "
          f"mail={briefing.mail_site} ({t_brief:.1f}s)")
    scenario = scenario_time(briefing.scenario_date)
    sites = {s["siteId"]: s for s in task["access"]}
    deadline = time.monotonic() + float(os.environ.get("CHECK_SECONDS", "600"))
    tabs = int(os.environ.get("MAIL_TABS", "5"))
    async with async_playwright() as playwright:
        bid_ctx, mail_ctx = await browsers.contexts(playwright, 2)
        timings: dict[str, float] = {}

        async def tender():
            started = time.monotonic()
            session = SiteSession(sites[briefing.bid_site], bid_ctx, trace)
            await asyncio.wait_for(session.start(), 90)
            result = await research_tender(session, briefing.tender_reference, scenario, deadline=deadline)
            timings["tender"] = time.monotonic() - started
            return result

        plan = asyncio.create_task(plan_searches(task["brief"]))  # planning overlaps the tabs' sign-in

        async def mail():
            started = time.monotonic()
            first = SiteSession(sites[briefing.mail_site], mail_ctx, trace)
            await first.start()  # signs in once; the other tabs share the context's cookies
            others = [SiteSession(sites[briefing.mail_site], mail_ctx, trace) for _ in range(tabs - 1)]
            await asyncio.gather(*(s.start() for s in others))
            kinds = await plan
            timings["mail_plan_ready"] = time.monotonic() - started
            result = await research_mail([first, *others], briefing.tender_reference, scenario, task["brief"],
                                         kinds=kinds, deadline=deadline)
            timings["mail"] = time.monotonic() - started
            return result

        jobs = {"tender": tender, "mail": mail}
        names = [n for n in ("tender", "mail") if n in parts]
        done = await asyncio.gather(*(jobs[n]() for n in names), return_exceptions=True)
        for name, value in zip(names, done):
            if isinstance(value, BaseException):
                print(f"{name} failed: {type(value).__name__}: {value}")
        results = {n: v for n, v in zip(names, done) if not isinstance(v, BaseException)}
    total = time.monotonic() - t0

    tender_facts, mail_facts = results.get("tender"), results.get("mail")
    if tender_facts is not None:
        dump("tender: Q&A records", tender_facts.qa)
        print("\n===== tender: positions")

                  f"{p.unit_text} (answer {p.quantity_answer}) group={p.condition_group} pack={p.packaging_key} "
                  f"term={p.commitment_key} pool={p.setup_pool_key} bonus={p.bonus_key} setup={p.setup_fee}")
        print(f"  withdrawn: {tender_facts.withdrawn}")
        for a in tender_facts.amendments:
            print(f"  amendment {a.date.isoformat()} {a.revision} {a.requirement} {a.attributes}")
    if mail_facts is not None:
        print("\n===== mail: sources")
        for s in sorted(mail_facts.sources, key=lambda s: (s.kind, s.sent_at)):
            flag = "USED" if s.used else ("rec " if s.is_record and s.has_content else "-   ")
            print(f"  {flag} {s.kind:<15} {s.sent_at.isoformat()} {s.sender:<36} "
                  f"{s.reference:<18} {s.subject}")
        dump("mail: facts", mail_facts.model_copy(update={"sources": []}))
    if tender_facts is not None and mail_facts is not None:
        dump("calc mapping", bid_clauses(tender_facts, mail_facts))
    print(f"\ntimings: brief {t_brief:.1f}s, " + ", ".join(f"{k} {v:.1f}s" for k, v in timings.items())
          + f", total {total:.1f}s")
    print(f"trace: {trace.path}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())

T = TypeVar("T", bound=BaseModel)

_REF = re.compile(r"\[e\d+ ")


def on_site(site: dict, url: str) -> str | None:
    """The absolute URL of a link target if it is on the site's own host (the goto tool's rule), else None."""
    target = urljoin(site["url"], url)
    return target if urlparse(target).netloc == urlparse(site["url"]).netloc else None


def _strip_refs(text: str) -> str:
    return _REF.sub("[", text)


def _slow_model():
    """The worker model with a client timeout that fits a thinking call reading a whole page (often 15 to 40 s);
    the default timeout is tuned for short navigation steps. Built synchronously, so concurrent calls keep theirs."""
    old = os.environ.get("LLM_TIMEOUT")
    os.environ["LLM_TIMEOUT"] = os.environ.get("LLM_READ_TIMEOUT", "90")
    try:
        return llm.model()
    finally:
        if old is None:
            os.environ.pop("LLM_TIMEOUT", None)
        else:
            os.environ["LLM_TIMEOUT"] = old


# Readers copy values from pages a worker chose, under a grounding check; thinking makes each call ~30 s instead of
# ~5 s for little gain there. Judgement calls (which revision governs) always think.
READ_THINKING = os.environ.get("RESEARCH_READ_THINKING", "0") == "1"


async def _grounded_read(output_type: type[T], instructions: str, prompt: str, source: str, *,
                         trace: Trace | None = None, name: str = "research", what: str = "") -> T:
    """One reader call: the model reports what `source` (the text it is shown) says; every value it returns must
    appear in that text, else it is told which ones do not and tries again. Traced with seconds and refusals."""
    agent = Agent(_slow_model(), output_type=output_type, instructions=instructions,
                  model_settings=llm.settings(thinking=READ_THINKING), retries=3)
    refusals: list[str] = []

    @agent.output_validator
    def _grounded(out):
        missing = unseen_values(out.model_dump_json(), source)
        if missing:
            refusals.extend(missing[:10])
            raise ModelRetry(f"{', '.join(missing[:10])} are not in the text; copy values exactly from it.")
        return out

    started = time.monotonic()
    try:
        return (await agent.run(prompt)).output
    finally:
        if trace:
            trace.event(name, "read", what=what, seconds=round(time.monotonic() - started, 1), refusals=refusals)


def same_revision(a: str, b: str) -> bool:
    """Revision labels as reported may carry a word around the id ("Revision R-2" vs "R-2")."""
    a, b = " ".join(a.split()).casefold(), " ".join(b.split()).casefold()
    return bool(a and b) and (a == b or a in b or b in a)


def _worker_kwargs(**kwargs) -> dict:
    """Pass optional run_worker options only when this harness version has them."""
    params = inspect.signature(run_worker).parameters
    return {k: v for k, v in kwargs.items() if k in params}

class ResearchSites(BaseModel):

                                       "its revisions")
    erp_site: str = Field(description="siteId of the bidder's own internal system with materials, stock, lead "
                                      "times and price conditions")


async def research_sites(task: dict) -> ResearchSites:
    """Map the specification and ERP roles to siteIds from the brief (the private run renames and re-splits)."""
    ids = {s["siteId"] for s in task["access"]}
    sites = "\n".join(f"- siteId {s['siteId']}: {s['url']}" for s in task["access"])
    agent = Agent(llm.model(), output_type=ResearchSites, model_settings=llm.settings(thinking=False), retries=3,
                  instructions="You read a task brief and say which website plays which part, using its siteIds.")

    @agent.output_validator
    def _known(out: ResearchSites) -> ResearchSites:
        if out.spec_site not in ids or out.erp_site not in ids:
            raise ModelRetry(f"spec_site and erp_site must be among these siteIds: {sorted(ids)}")
        return out

    brief = task["brief"].split("## Site access")[0]
    result = await agent.run(f"Websites of this run:\n{sites}\n\nBrief:\n{brief}")
    return result.output


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- tools that read what the model chose

_DOCUMENTS: dict[int, list[str]] = {}  # id(session) -> page texts read by read_document


def _common_edges(texts: list[str]) -> tuple[int, int]:
    """Lines shared at the start and at the end of every text (site chrome), to show them only once."""
    lines = [t.splitlines() for t in texts]
    if len(lines) < 2:
        return 0, 0
    head = 0
    while all(len(x) > head for x in lines) and len({x[head] for x in lines}) == 1:
        head += 1
    tail = 0
    while all(len(x) > head + tail for x in lines) and len({x[-1 - tail] for x in lines}) == 1:
        tail += 1
    return head, tail


async def open_pages(ctx: RunContext[Deps], paths: list[str]) -> str:
    """Read several pages of this website in one step, e.g. the tabs, sub-views or records of what you are
    investigating. Give link targets exactly as pages you have seen show them (at most 8). The texts come back
    without refs; you end up on the last one (read_more(offset=0) shows its refs)."""
    session = ctx.deps.session
    texts, names = [], []
    for path in paths[:8]:
        parsed = urlparse(path)
        rel = parsed.path + (f"?{parsed.query}" if parsed.query else "")
        if path not in session.seen and rel not in session.seen:
            texts.append("not opened: no page you have seen links there")
            names.append(path)
            continue
        target = urljoin(session.page.url, path)
        if urlparse(target).netloc != urlparse(session.site["url"]).netloc:
            texts.append("not opened: not on this website")
            names.append(path)
            continue
        async with session.lock:
            await session._goto(target)
            session.trace.event(session.name, "action", action="open_pages", url=target)
            view = await session.look()
        landed = urlparse(session.page.url)
        wanted = urlparse(target)
        if (landed.path, landed.query) != (wanted.path, wanted.query):
            texts.append(f"did not open: the site showed {session.page.url} instead (handle that page, then open "
                         f"this view again)\n" + _strip_refs(view.split("\n\n", 1)[-1])[:3000])
            names.append(path)
            continue
        texts.append(_strip_refs(view.split("\n\n", 1)[-1])[:8000])
        names.append(path)
    def opened(text: str) -> bool:
        return not text.startswith(("not opened", "did not open"))

    head, tail = _common_edges([t for t in texts if opened(t)])
    out = []
    for i, (name, text) in enumerate(zip(names, texts)):
        if i and opened(text) and (head or tail):
            lines = text.splitlines()
            text = "\n".join(lines[head:len(lines) - tail]) + "\n[page frame as in the first page]"
        out.append(f"=== {name}\n{text}")
    return "\n\n".join(out)


def _control(view: str, ref: str) -> tuple[str, str] | None:
    m = re.search(r"\[" + re.escape(ref) + r' (\w+) "([^"]*)"', view)
    return (m.group(1), m.group(2)) if m else None


async def _click(element) -> None:
    try:
        await element.click(timeout=5000)
    except Exception:
        await element.evaluate("e => e.click()")


async def read_document(ctx: RunContext[Deps], next_ref: str = "") -> str:
    """Read the whole document you have open: give the ref of its control that shows the next page or loads more
    (next_ref), and every page is read in turn and kept for extraction. Leave next_ref empty when the document has
    a single page. Call it while the document version you chose is open."""
    session = ctx.deps.session
    pages = [session.view]
    control = _control(session.view, next_ref) if next_ref else None
    if next_ref and control is None:
        return f"No control {next_ref} in the current view; use a ref from the latest view."
    if control:
        role, label = control
        pattern = re.compile(r"\[(e\d+) " + re.escape(role) + r' "' + re.escape(label) + r'"(?![^\]]*disabled)')
        nth = [m.group(1) for m in pattern.finditer(session.view)].index(next_ref)
        seen = {_strip_refs(session.view)}
        for _ in range(40):
            refs = [m.group(1) for m in pattern.finditer(session.view)]
            if not refs:
                break
            await session.act("click", refs[min(nth, len(refs) - 1)], _click)
            text = _strip_refs(session.view)
            if text in seen:  # past the end some sites repeat the last page
                break
            seen.add(text)
            pages.append(session.view)
    # "load more" pages contain the earlier ones: keep only pages no later page contains
    stripped = [_strip_refs(p) for p in pages]
    keep = [p for i, p in enumerate(stripped) if not any(p in later for later in stripped[i + 1:])]
    _DOCUMENTS[id(session)] = keep
    session.trace.event(session.name, "read_document", pages=len(pages), kept=len(keep),
                        chars=sum(len(p) for p in keep))
    return (f"Read {len(pages)} views of the document ({len(keep)} distinct, {sum(len(p) for p in keep)} "
            f"characters); they are kept for extraction. Return your result now.\n\n" + await session.look())

FIND_SPEC_GOAL = """\

subject; documents may be listed over several pages) and open it. If the site asks for a confirmation before
releasing documents, choose the option that gives access to the binding documents (archive copies or previews
are not the governing ones) and copy any number it asks you to transfer exactly. Stop at the document's revision
history and return every revision it lists with its status as shown (statuses may only be visible in tooltips)."""

CHOOSE_REVISION = """\

(in whatever words the site uses), never one marked as superseded, replaced or withdrawn. Documents may list or open the
oldest revision first, and dates may be written in different orders, so go by the marked status; use dates only if
no status marks one revision as current."""

OPEN_REVISION_GOAL = """\
Open the requirements of revision {revision} of the specification document you have open (not another revision).
Once its first page of requirements shows, call read_document with the ref of the control that shows the next page
or loads more (leave it empty if everything is on one page), so that all its requirements are read; then return."""

EXTRACT_INSTRUCTIONS = """\
You extract requirements from one page of a technical specification exactly as written. Copy numbers as shown
including any locale tag next to them; never convert, compute or guess. Each requirement may appear both as
a table row and in its full original wording (which wins if they differ). Report only requirements that this page

async def _extract_page(text: str, document: str, revision: str, context: str, trace: Trace | None,
                        name: str) -> SpecPage | None:
    prompt = f"Document {document}, revision {revision} (the current one).\nContext: {context}\n\nPage:\n{text}"
    try:
        return await _grounded_read(SpecPage, EXTRACT_INSTRUCTIONS, prompt, text, trace=trace, name=name,
                                    what="spec page")
    except Exception as error:  # one bad page must not sink the rest
        print(f"[research] spec page extraction failed: {type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:200]}", flush=True)
        return None


async def _choose_revision(history: RevisionHistory, view: str, context: str) -> CurrentRevision | None:
    ids = {r.revision.strip() for r in history.revisions}
    agent = Agent(_slow_model(), output_type=CurrentRevision, instructions=CHOOSE_REVISION,
                  model_settings=llm.settings(thinking=True), retries=3)

    @agent.output_validator
    def _listed(out: CurrentRevision) -> CurrentRevision:
        if not any(same_revision(out.revision, i) for i in ids):
            raise ModelRetry(f"Choose one of the listed revisions: {sorted(ids)}")
        return out

    listing = "\n".join(f"- {r.revision}: {r.status}" for r in history.revisions)
    prompt = (f"{context}\n\nDocument: {history.document}\nRevisions as reported:\n{listing}\n\n"
              f"The revision history page:\n{_strip_refs(view)[:12000]}")
    try:
        return (await agent.run(prompt)).output
    except Exception as error:
        print(f"[research] revision choice failed: {type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:200]}", flush=True)
        return None


def _parse_requirement(seen: RequirementSeen, revision: str) -> Requirement:
    return Requirement(
        requirement_id=seen.requirement_id.strip(), revision=revision, bore=parse_number(seen.bore),
        stroke=parse_number(seen.stroke), pressure=parse_number(seen.pressure), mounting=seen.mounting.strip(),
        certification=seen.certification.strip(), catalog_group=seen.catalog_group.strip(),
        pieces_per_set=parse_int(seen.pieces_per_set) if seen.pieces_per_set.strip() else None,
        stroke_is_usable=seen.stroke_is_usable_travel, reserve_key=seen.reserve_key.strip() or None,
        raw={k: str(v) for k, v in seen.model_dump().items()})


async def research_spec(session: SiteSession, briefing: Briefing, *, context: str = "",
                        deadline: float | None = None, on_requirement=None, on_revision=None) -> SpecResult:
    """
    The current specification revision's requirements: a worker finds the document and its revision history
    (navigation, thinking off), a model decides the current revision (thinking on), the worker opens it and pages
    through it, and a model extracts each page (thinking on, in parallel).

    `on_revision()` runs once the governing revision is chosen (e.g. to warm up the ERP), `on_requirement(req)` as
    soon as each requirement is parsed, so ERP research can start before the last page is read.
    """
    started = time.monotonic()
    result = SpecResult()
    goal_context = f"Tender reference: {briefing.tender_reference}\n{context}".strip()

    def finish(problem: str | None = None) -> SpecResult:
        if problem:
            result.problems.append(problem)
        result.seconds = round(time.monotonic() - started, 1)
        session.trace.event(session.name, "spec_done", seconds=result.seconds, revision=result.current_revision,
                            requirements=[r.requirement_id for r in result.requirements], problems=result.problems)
        return result

    history, _ = await run_worker(session, FIND_SPEC_GOAL, RevisionHistory, context=goal_context, deadline=deadline,
                                  max_steps=25, **_worker_kwargs(notes=False))
    if history is None or not history.revisions:
        return finish("no revision history found")
    result.document = history.document
    result.revisions = [SpecRevision(revision=r.revision, status_shown=r.status) for r in history.revisions]
    choice = await _choose_revision(history, session.view, goal_context)
    if choice is None:
        return finish("no current revision chosen")
    result.current_revision = choice.revision.strip()
    session.trace.event(session.name, "spec_revision", revision=result.current_revision, why=choice.why)
    if on_revision:
        on_revision()

    for _ in range(2):
        await run_worker(session, OPEN_REVISION_GOAL.format(revision=result.current_revision), Opened,
                         context=goal_context, deadline=deadline, max_steps=12, tools=(read_document,),
                         **_worker_kwargs(notes=False, grounded=False))
        pages = _DOCUMENTS.pop(id(session), [])
        if pages:
            break
    else:
        return finish(f"revision {result.current_revision} could not be read")
    session.trace.event(session.name, "spec_extract", pages=len(pages))
    by_id: dict[str, Requirement] = {}

    async def extract(text: str) -> SpecPage | None:
        page = await _extract_page(text, history.document, result.current_revision, goal_context, session.trace,
                                   session.name)
        if page and on_requirement and not (page.revision_shown and not same_revision(page.revision_shown,
                                                                                      result.current_revision)):
            for seen in page.requirements:
                try:
                    req = _parse_requirement(seen, result.current_revision)
                except ParseError:
                    continue
                if req.requirement_id not in streamed:
                    streamed.add(req.requirement_id)
                    on_requirement(req)
        return page

    streamed: set[str] = set()
    extracted = await asyncio.gather(*(extract(p) for p in pages))
    for page in extracted:
        if page is None:
            result.problems.append("a document page could not be extracted")
            continue
        if page.revision_shown and not same_revision(page.revision_shown, result.current_revision):
            result.problems.append(f"a page shows revision {page.revision_shown}, not {result.current_revision}")
            continue
        for seen in page.requirements:
            try:
                req = _parse_requirement(seen, result.current_revision)
            except ParseError as error:
                result.problems.append(f"{seen.requirement_id}: {error}")
                continue
            if seen.conflict:
                result.problems.append(f"{req.requirement_id}: {seen.conflict}")
            if req.requirement_id in by_id and by_id[req.requirement_id].raw != req.raw:
                result.problems.append(f"{req.requirement_id} read differently on two pages")
            by_id.setdefault(req.requirement_id, req)
    result.requirements = sorted(by_id.values(), key=lambda r: calc.position_key(r.requirement_id))
    return finish()

"""
The agent's entry point: agent.json runs `uv run --no-sync python agent.py`, in the sandbox and on your machine.

v1: read the brief, then sign and submit a bid with every position omitted (eligible, decision and reference
points). Workers for the specification, ERP and pricing come in v2+. See docs/plan.md.
"""
import asyncio
import json
import sys
import time

import browsers
import run as contract
from briefing import read_brief
from browser_tools import SiteSession
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
from submit import Mailbox, submit_bid
from tracing import Trace

SAFETY_SECONDS = 90  # the answer must be in before the run expires
LOCAL_SECONDS = 20 * 60  # the scouting run does not expire; behave like a scored run


async def solve(task: dict, page) -> dict | None:
    """Enter the bid on the run's website (a "site" submission) and return None."""
    trace = Trace()
    left = min(contract.seconds_left(task), LOCAL_SECONDS)
    deadline = time.monotonic() + left - SAFETY_SECONDS
    # Sign in to every website while the model reads the brief: which one plays which part is only known after it.
    contexts = await browsers.more_contexts(page, len(task["access"]))
    sessions = {site["siteId"]: SiteSession(site, context, trace) for site, context in zip(task["access"], contexts)}
    started = asyncio.gather(*(session.start() for session in sessions.values()), return_exceptions=True)
    briefing, outcomes = await asyncio.gather(read_brief(task), started)
    trace.event("briefing", "done", **briefing.model_dump(exclude={"submission_steps"}))
    failed = {name for name, outcome in zip(sessions, outcomes) if isinstance(outcome, BaseException)}
    bid, mail = sessions[briefing.bid_site], sessions[briefing.mail_site]
    await asyncio.gather(*(session.start() for session in (bid, mail) if session.name in failed))
    result = await submit_bid(bid, Mailbox(mail, briefing, deadline), briefing, deadline)
    trace.event("result", "done", result=result.model_dump() if result else None)
    return None


async def main() -> int:
    task, token = contract.load_run()
    sites = ", ".join(f"{site.get('siteId')} {site.get('url')}" for site in task["access"])
    print(f"Run {task.get('run_id') or '(local: the scouting logins, nothing counts)'}; websites: {sites}; "
          f"answer via {task['submission']['kind']}", flush=True)
    async with async_playwright() as playwright:
        browser, page = await browsers.connect(playwright)  # more browsers: browsers.connect(playwright, 1), ...
        answer = await solve(task, page)
    if answer is None:
        print("No answer to submit through the API: the bid is entered on the website", flush=True)
        return 0
    if not token:
        print("Your answer (locally nothing is submitted):", json.dumps(answer, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
        return 0
    status, body = contract.submit_answer(task, token, answer)
    print(f"Answer: HTTP {status} {body[:2000]}", flush=True)
    return 0 if status == 202 else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(asyncio.run(main()))
"""
Enter, sign and submit the bid: a worker on the bid website follows the brief's submission steps, and asks the
bidder's webmail (a second worker in its own tab) for the contact address and, once requested, the signing TAN.

The bid worker runs in two phases: filling the form up to the signing step (plain navigation, thinking off by
default), then requesting the TAN, entering it and submitting. Between them one model call checks the
summary against the requirements; the signing phase thinks only when that check fails or finds problems.
THINKING_FORM, THINKING_REVIEW (the check) and THINKING_SIGN override these defaults (see llm.thinking).
"""
import asyncio
import os
from typing import Literal

import browser_tools
import llm
from briefing import Briefing
from browser_tools import Deps, SiteSession
from extract import locate
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from pydantic_ai import Agent, RunContext
from worker import run_worker

ADDRESS_WAIT = 15  # seconds the bid worker waits for the contact address before it starts without it
# AGENT_FILL_IN=0 leaves out fill_in(), the several-actions-per-step form tool


class MailboxAddress(BaseModel):
    address: str = Field(description="The email address of the mailbox you are signed in to")


class SigningTan(BaseModel):
    tan: str = Field(description="The TAN exactly as the message shows it")
    subject: str
    received: str = Field(description="When the message arrived, as shown")


class FormReady(BaseModel):
    at_signing_step: bool = Field(description="True when the page now shows the final review with the signing step")
    open_points: str = Field(description="Anything you could not enter or that the page still asks for; '' if none")


class SubmissionResult(BaseModel):
    submitted: bool = Field(description="True only when the website confirmed the bid as submitted")
    confirmation: str = Field(description="The website's confirmation or error text, word for word")
    omitted_positions: list[str] = Field(description="Position numbers the summary lists as omitted")


class Mailbox:
    """The bidder's webmail, worked by the model on request; one request at a time in its tab."""

    def __init__(self, session: SiteSession, briefing: Briefing, deadline: float):
        self.session, self.briefing, self.deadline = session, briefing, deadline
        self.lock = asyncio.Lock()
        self.last_tan = ""

    async def address(self) -> str:
        async with self.lock:
            found, _ = await run_worker(
                self.session, "Find the email address of the mailbox you are signed in to (the bidder's own "
                "address, usually shown as the signed-in account). Return it at once.",
                MailboxAddress, deadline=self.deadline, max_steps=8, notes=False)
        return found.address if found else ""

    async def tan(self, answer: str = "") -> SigningTan | None:
        """
        The signing TAN just requested. The sites run on the scenario's clock, so "newest" is the highest request
        number or the top of the list, never a wall-clock time. `answer` is what the bid website said to the request
        (it may name the request), so the mail worker can pick that very message.
        """
        older = f" The TAN {self.last_tan} you returned before is no longer valid." if self.last_tan else ""
        said = (f" The bid website answered the request with: {answer!r}; pick the message for that request."
                if answer else "")
        async with self.lock:
            async with self.session.lock:  # the list the tab shows predates the request: load it again
                await self.session._goto(self.session.page.url)
            found, _ = await run_worker(
                self.session, f"A new signing TAN for tender {self.briefing.tender_reference} was just requested."
                f"{said} Open the newest signing TAN message for exactly this tender reference (the highest "
                "request number; new TAN messages are listed without a search, newest first; reload the list once "
                "if it is not there yet), copy the TAN from its text and return it at once. If a preview pane "
                f"stays empty, open the message's own page through its link.{older}",
                SigningTan, context=answer, deadline=self.deadline, max_steps=10, notes=False)
        if found:
            self.last_tan = found.tan
        return found


class FormAction(BaseModel):
    ref: str = Field(description="The element's ref in the latest view")
    action: Literal["fill", "select", "check", "uncheck", "click"]
    value: str = Field("", description="fill: the text to type; select: the option's visible text, exactly as the "
                                       "view lists it; empty for check, uncheck and click")


async def _perform(element, step: FormAction) -> None:
    if step.action == "fill":
        await element.fill(step.value, timeout=2000)
    elif step.action == "select":
        if not step.value:
            raise ValueError("select needs the option's visible text as value")
        try:
            await element.select_option(label=step.value, timeout=2000)
        except Exception:
            await element.select_option(step.value, timeout=2000)
    elif step.action in ("check", "uncheck"):
        await element.set_checked(step.action == "check", timeout=2000)
    else:
        try:
            await element.click(timeout=5000)
        except Exception:
            await element.evaluate("e => e.click()")


async def fill_in(ctx: RunContext[Deps], actions: list[FormAction]) -> str:
    """
    Do several actions on the current page in one go, in this order: fill textboxes, choose options, tick boxes,
    or click buttons that keep you on this page (such as one per table row). Use refs from the latest view. It
    stops at the first action that fails or that leaves the page, and returns the new view. Put a button that
    moves to the next step only last, or click it on its own.
    """
    session = ctx.deps.session
    done: list[str] = []
    stop = ""
    async with session.lock:
        page, url, windows = session.page, session.page.url, len(session.pages)
        for step in actions:
            element = await locate(page, step.ref)
            if element is None:
                stop = f"no element {step.ref} (the page changed; use the new view)"
                break
            try:
                await _perform(element, step)
            except Exception as error:
                stop = f"{step.action} {step.ref} {step.value!r} failed: {str(error).splitlines()[0][:200]}"
                break
            done.append(f"{step.action} {step.ref}")
            await asyncio.sleep(0.15)
            if page.is_closed() or page.url != url or len(session.pages) != windows:
                if step is not actions[-1]:
                    stop = "the page changed after it; the remaining actions were not done"
                break
        await asyncio.sleep(0.25)
        await session.settle()
        session.trace.event(session.name, "action", action="fill_in", done=done, stop=stop,
                            asked=[step.model_dump() for step in actions])
        view = await session.look()
    report = f"Done: {', '.join(done) or 'nothing'}." + (f" Stopped: {stop}." if stop else "")
    return f"{report}\n\n{view}"


def _requirements(briefing: Briefing, email: str) -> str:
    contact = repr(email) if email else "the contact email from bidder_contact_email()"
    return f"""- decision: bid (main offer, not an alternative offer);
- leave every position out with the form's option to omit a position (where the form shows one position per
  step, omit each in turn); do not configure materials, prices or lead times, and never use options that add
  positions;
- discount 0 and net total 0,00 (German number format);
- register with company name {briefing.company_name!r}, VAT id {briefing.vat_id!r} and contact email {contact};
- tick the form's acknowledgement of the tender documents (no need to open them), but do not tick declarations
  that make your own terms and conditions apply."""


class SummaryCheck(BaseModel):
    matches: bool = Field(description="True when the page contradicts none of the requirements")
    problems: str = Field(description="Each requirement the page visibly contradicts, with what the page shows; "
                                      "'' if none")


async def check_summary(view: str, requirements: str) -> SummaryCheck | None:
    """One model call (thinking off by default, THINKING_REVIEW) on the review page before signing."""
    agent = Agent(llm.model(), output_type=SummaryCheck, retries=2,
                  model_settings=llm.settings(llm.thinking("review", False)),
                  instructions="You check the final review page of a bid against the bidder's requirements before "
                               "it is signed. Report only what the page visibly contradicts (a wrong or missing "
                               "value, a position that is not omitted, an extra position, a wrong offer type); "
                               "requirements the page does not show at all are no problem.")
    try:
        result = await asyncio.wait_for(agent.run(f"Requirements:\n{requirements}\n\nReview page:\n{view}"), 90)
    except Exception:  # a failed check means the signing worker checks the page itself, with thinking on
        return None
    return result.output


async def submit_bid(bid_session: SiteSession, mailbox: Mailbox, briefing: Briefing, deadline: float
                     ) -> SubmissionResult | None:
    """v1: a bid with every position omitted, discount 0 % and net total 0, signed and submitted."""
    address = asyncio.create_task(mailbox.address())
    try:  # the lookup takes a step or two; knowing the address up front saves the bid worker a round trip
        email = await asyncio.wait_for(asyncio.shield(address), ADDRESS_WAIT)
    except asyncio.TimeoutError:
        email = ""
    if email:
        bid_session.seen += "\n" + email  # it comes from another website; let results use it

    async def bidder_contact_email(reason: str = "") -> str:
        """The bidder's contact email address, read from the bidder's own webmail."""
        found = await address
        bid_session.seen += "\n" + found
        return found or "not found: the webmail did not show it"

    async def request_signing_tan(ctx: RunContext[Deps], ref: str) -> str:
        """
        Click the website's control that requests the signing TAN (its ref in the latest view), then fetch that
        TAN from the bidder's webmail. Returns the page after the request and the TAN: enter it right away (it is
        valid for five minutes, and any new request invalidates it).
        """
        before = set(bid_session.view.splitlines())
        view = await browser_tools.click(ctx, ref)
        answer = " ".join(line.strip() for line in bid_session.view.splitlines()
                          if line.strip() and line not in before and "[e" not in line)[:400]
        found = await mailbox.tan(answer)
        if not found:
            return f"{view}\n\nNo TAN found in the webmail. Request a new TAN with this tool again."
        bid_session.seen += "\n" + found.tan
        return f"{view}\n\nTAN from the webmail: {found.tan} (message {found.subject!r}, received {found.received})."

    tools = (bidder_contact_email,) if not email else ()
    batch = os.environ.get("AGENT_FILL_IN", "1") != "0"
    if batch:
        tools += (fill_in,)
    several = ("Enter everything a page asks for with one fill_in() call (all its fields, boxes and per-row "
               "buttons), then move on.\n" if batch else "")
    form_goal = f"""Fill in the bid for tender {briefing.tender_reference} on this website, following the brief's
submission steps below, up to the final review and signing step. For this bid:
{_requirements(briefing, email)}
{several}Stop at the final review with the signing step: do not request a TAN and do not submit there.
Return as soon as that page shows. Refs change with every view: read a button's label in the latest view before
clicking it.

Brief's submission steps:
{briefing.submission_steps}"""
    ready, _ = await run_worker(bid_session, form_goal, FormReady, deadline=deadline, max_steps=45, notes=False,
                                thinking=llm.thinking("form", False), tools=tools)

    requirements = _requirements(briefing, email)
    check = await check_summary(bid_session.view, requirements) if ready and ready.at_signing_step else None
    bid_session.trace.event(bid_session.name, "summary_check", **(check.model_dump() if check else {}))
    if check and check.matches:
        task = ("The form was filled in up to the signing step by an earlier pass, and its summary was checked "
                "against the requirements below; the current view shows it.")
    elif check:
        task = (f"The form was filled in up to the signing step by an earlier pass, but a check of the summary "
                f"found: {check.problems} Fix that first (mind the page's warnings about going back).")
    else:
        task = ("An earlier pass started filling in the form but may not have finished; continue from the current "
                "view, and check the summary against the requirements below." +
                (f" It reported: {ready.open_points}" if ready and ready.open_points else ""))
    if os.environ.get("AGENT_STOP_BEFORE_SIGN") == "1":  # local timing runs: never request a TAN (shared webmail)
        address.cancel()
        return None
    careful = not (check and check.matches)
    review_goal = f"""Sign and submit the bid for tender {briefing.tender_reference} on this website. {task}
The bid must be:
{requirements}
Request the signing TAN only with request_signing_tan(ref of the website's TAN request button), never by clicking
that button yourself; enter the TAN it returns at once and submit bindingly. Browser confirmation dialogs are
accepted for you. Return once the website confirms the submission (or shows why it failed).

Brief's submission steps:
{briefing.submission_steps}"""
    result = None
    try:
        result, _ = await run_worker(bid_session, review_goal, SubmissionResult, deadline=deadline, max_steps=30,
                                     notes=False, thinking=llm.thinking("sign", careful),
                                     tools=(*tools, request_signing_tan))
    except Exception as error:  # in a run, the platform closes the model token once the bid is in
        bid_session.trace.event(bid_session.name, "stopped", reason=f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:200]}")
    if not address.done():
        address.cancel()
    return result

                MailboxAddress, deadline=self.deadline, max_steps=8, notes=False)
        return found.address if found else ""

    async def tan(self, answer: str = "") -> SigningTan | None:
        """
        The signing TAN just requested. The sites run on the scenario's clock, so "newest" is the highest request
        number or the top of the list, never a wall-clock time. `answer` is what the bid website said to the request
        (it may name the request), so the mail worker can pick that very message.
        """
        older = f" The TAN {self.last_tan} you returned before is no longer valid." if self.last_tan else ""
        said = (f" The bid website answered the request with: {answer!r}; pick the message for that request."
                if answer else "")
        async with self.lock:
            async with self.session.lock:  # the list the tab shows predates the request: load it again
                await self.session._goto(self.session.page.url)
            found, _ = await run_worker(
                self.session, f"A new signing TAN for tender {self.briefing.tender_reference} was just requested."
                f"{said} Open the newest signing TAN message for exactly this tender reference (the highest "
                "request number; new TAN messages are listed without a search, newest first; reload the list once "
                "if it is not there yet), copy the TAN from its text and return it at once. If a preview pane "
                f"stays empty, open the message's own page through its link.{older}",
                SigningTan, context=answer, deadline=self.deadline, max_steps=10, notes=False)
        if found:
            self.last_tan = found.tan
        return found


class FormAction(BaseModel):
    ref: str = Field(description="The element's ref in the latest view")
    action: Literal["fill", "select", "check", "uncheck", "click"]
    value: str = Field("", description="fill: the text to type; select: the option's visible text, exactly as the "
                                       "view lists it; empty for check, uncheck and click")


async def _perform(element, step: FormAction) -> None:
    if step.action == "fill":
        await element.fill(step.value, timeout=2000)
    elif step.action == "select":
        if not step.value:
            raise ValueError("select needs the option's visible text as value")
        try:
            await element.select_option(label=step.value, timeout=2000)
        except Exception:
            await element.select_option(step.value, timeout=2000)
    elif step.action in ("check", "uncheck"):
        await element.set_checked(step.action == "check", timeout=2000)
    else:
        try:
            await element.click(timeout=5000)
        except Exception:
            await element.evaluate("e => e.click()")


async def fill_in(ctx: RunContext[Deps], actions: list[FormAction]) -> str:
    """
    Do several actions on the current page in one go, in this order: fill textboxes, choose options, tick boxes,
    or click buttons that keep you on this page (such as one per table row). Use refs from the latest view. It
    stops at the first action that fails or that leaves the page, and returns the new view. Put a button that
    moves to the next step only last, or click it on its own.
    """
    session = ctx.deps.session
    done: list[str] = []
    stop = ""
    async with session.lock:
        page, url, windows = session.page, session.page.url, len(session.pages)
        for step in actions:
            element = await locate(page, step.ref)
            if element is None:
                stop = f"no element {step.ref} (the page changed; use the new view)"
                break
            try:
                await _perform(element, step)
            except Exception as error:
                stop = f"{step.action} {step.ref} {step.value!r} failed: {str(error).splitlines()[0][:200]}"
                break
            done.append(f"{step.action} {step.ref}")
            await asyncio.sleep(0.15)
            if page.is_closed() or page.url != url or len(session.pages) != windows:
                if step is not actions[-1]:
                    stop = "the page changed after it; the remaining actions were not done"
                break
        await asyncio.sleep(0.25)
        await session.settle()
        session.trace.event(session.name, "action", action="fill_in", done=done, stop=stop,
                            asked=[step.model_dump() for step in actions])
        view = await session.look()
    report = f"Done: {', '.join(done) or 'nothing'}." + (f" Stopped: {stop}." if stop else "")
    return f"{report}\n\n{view}"


def _requirements(briefing: Briefing, email: str) -> str:
    contact = repr(email) if email else "the contact email from bidder_contact_email()"
    return f"""- decision: bid (main offer, not an alternative offer);
- leave every position out with the form's option to omit a position (where the form shows one position per
  step, omit each in turn); do not configure materials, prices or lead times, and never use options that add
  positions;
- discount 0 and net total 0,00 (German number format);
- register with company name {briefing.company_name!r}, VAT id {briefing.vat_id!r} and contact email {contact};
- tick the form's acknowledgement of the tender documents (no need to open them), but do not tick declarations
  that make your own terms and conditions apply."""


class SummaryCheck(BaseModel):
    matches: bool = Field(description="True when the page contradicts none of the requirements")
    problems: str = Field(description="Each requirement the page visibly contradicts, with what the page shows; "
                                      "'' if none")


async def check_summary(view: str, requirements: str) -> SummaryCheck | None:
    """One model call (thinking off by default, THINKING_REVIEW) on the review page before signing."""
    agent = Agent(llm.model(), output_type=SummaryCheck, retries=2,
                  model_settings=llm.settings(llm.thinking("review", False)),
                  instructions="You check the final review page of a bid against the bidder's requirements before "
                               "it is signed. Report only what the page visibly contradicts (a wrong or missing "
                               "value, a position that is not omitted, an extra position, a wrong offer type); "
                               "requirements the page does not show at all are no problem.")
    try:
        result = await asyncio.wait_for(agent.run(f"Requirements:\n{requirements}\n\nReview page:\n{view}"), 90)
    except Exception:  # a failed check means the signing worker checks the page itself, with thinking on
        return None
    return result.output


async def submit_bid(bid_session: SiteSession, mailbox: Mailbox, briefing: Briefing, deadline: float
                     ) -> SubmissionResult | None:
    """v1: a bid with every position omitted, discount 0 % and net total 0, signed and submitted."""
    address = asyncio.create_task(mailbox.address())
    try:  # the lookup takes a step or two; knowing the address up front saves the bid worker a round trip
        email = await asyncio.wait_for(asyncio.shield(address), ADDRESS_WAIT)
    except asyncio.TimeoutError:
        email = ""
    if email:
        bid_session.seen += "\n" + email  # it comes from another website; let results use it

    async def bidder_contact_email(reason: str = "") -> str:
        """The bidder's contact email address, read from the bidder's own webmail."""
        found = await address
        bid_session.seen += "\n" + found
        return found or "not found: the webmail did not show it"

    async def request_signing_tan(ctx: RunContext[Deps], ref: str) -> str:
        """
        Click the website's control that requests the signing TAN (its ref in the latest view), then fetch that
        TAN from the bidder's webmail. Returns the page after the request and the TAN: enter it right away (it is
        valid for five minutes, and any new request invalidates it).
        """
        before = set(bid_session.view.splitlines())
        view = await browser_tools.click(ctx, ref)
        answer = " ".join(line.strip() for line in bid_session.view.splitlines()
                          if line.strip() and line not in before and "[e" not in line)[:400]
        found = await mailbox.tan(answer)
        if not found:
            return f"{view}\n\nNo TAN found in the webmail. Request a new TAN with this tool again."
        bid_session.seen += "\n" + found.tan
        return f"{view}\n\nTAN from the webmail: {found.tan} (message {found.subject!r}, received {found.received})."

    tools = (bidder_contact_email,) if not email else ()
    batch = os.environ.get("AGENT_FILL_IN", "1") != "0"
    if batch:
        tools += (fill_in,)
    several = ("Enter everything a page asks for with one fill_in() call (all its fields, boxes and per-row "
               "buttons), then move on.\n" if batch else "")
    form_goal = f"""Fill in the bid for tender {briefing.tender_reference} on this website, following the brief's
submission steps below, up to the final review and signing step. For this bid:
{_requirements(briefing, email)}
{several}Stop at the final review with the signing step: do not request a TAN and do not submit there.
Return as soon as that page shows. Refs change with every view: read a button's label in the latest view before
clicking it.

Brief's submission steps:
{briefing.submission_steps}"""
    ready, _ = await run_worker(bid_session, form_goal, FormReady, deadline=deadline, max_steps=45, notes=False,
                                thinking=llm.thinking("form", False), tools=tools)

    requirements = _requirements(briefing, email)
    check = await check_summary(bid_session.view, requirements) if ready and ready.at_signing_step else None
    bid_session.trace.event(bid_session.name, "summary_check", **(check.model_dump() if check else {}))
    if check and check.matches:
        task = ("The form was filled in up to the signing step by an earlier pass, and its summary was checked "
                "against the requirements below; the current view shows it.")
    elif check:
        task = (f"The form was filled in up to the signing step by an earlier pass, but a check of the summary "
                f"found: {check.problems} Fix that first (mind the page's warnings about going back).")
    else:
        task = ("An earlier pass started filling in the form but may not have finished; continue from the current "
                "view, and check the summary against the requirements below." +
                (f" It reported: {ready.open_points}" if ready and ready.open_points else ""))
    if os.environ.get("AGENT_STOP_BEFORE_SIGN") == "1":  # local timing runs: never request a TAN (shared webmail)
        address.cancel()
        return None
    careful = not (check and check.matches)
    review_goal = f"""Sign and submit the bid for tender {briefing.tender_reference} on this website. {task}
The bid must be:
{requirements}
Request the signing TAN only with request_signing_tan(ref of the website's TAN request button), never by clicking
that button yourself; enter the TAN it returns at once and submit bindingly. Browser confirmation dialogs are
accepted for you. Return once the website confirms the submission (or shows why it failed).

Brief's submission steps:
{briefing.submission_steps}"""
    result = None
    try:
        result, _ = await run_worker(bid_session, review_goal, SubmissionResult, deadline=deadline, max_steps=30,
                                     notes=False, thinking=llm.thinking("sign", careful),
                                     tools=(*tools, request_signing_tan))
    except Exception as error:  # in a run, the platform closes the model token once the bid is in
        bid_session.trace.event(bid_session.name, "stopped", reason=f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:200]}")
    if not address.done():
        address.cancel()
    return result

async def research_spec(session: SiteSession, briefing: Briefing, *, context: str = "",
                        deadline: float | None = None, on_requirement=None, on_revision=None) -> SpecResult:
    """
    The current specification revision's requirements: a worker finds the document and its revision history
    (navigation, thinking off), a model decides the current revision (thinking on), the worker opens it and pages
    through it, and a model extracts each page (thinking on, in parallel).

    `on_revision()` runs once the governing revision is chosen (e.g. to warm up the ERP), `on_requirement(req)` as
    soon as each requirement is parsed, so ERP research can start before the last page is read.
    """
    started = time.monotonic()
    result = SpecResult()
    goal_context = f"Tender reference: {briefing.tender_reference}\n{context}".strip()

    def finish(problem: str | None = None) -> SpecResult:
        if problem:
            result.problems.append(problem)
        result.seconds = round(time.monotonic() - started, 1)
        session.trace.event(session.name, "spec_done", seconds=result.seconds, revision=result.current_revision,
                            requirements=[r.requirement_id for r in result.requirements], problems=result.problems)
        return result

    history, _ = await run_worker(session, FIND_SPEC_GOAL, RevisionHistory, context=goal_context, deadline=deadline,
                                  max_steps=25, **_worker_kwargs(notes=False))
    if history is None or not history.revisions:
        return finish("no revision history found")
    result.document = history.document
    result.revisions = [SpecRevision(revision=r.revision, status_shown=r.status) for r in history.revisions]
    choice = await _choose_revision(history, session.view, goal_context)
    if choice is None:
        return finish("no current revision chosen")
    result.current_revision = choice.revision.strip()
    session.trace.event(session.name, "spec_revision", revision=result.current_revision, why=choice.why)
    if on_revision:
        on_revision()

    for _ in range(2):
        await run_worker(session, OPEN_REVISION_GOAL.format(revision=result.current_revision), Opened,
                         context=goal_context, deadline=deadline, max_steps=12, tools=(read_document,),
                         **_worker_kwargs(notes=False, grounded=False))
        pages = _DOCUMENTS.pop(id(session), [])
        if pages:
            break
    else:
        return finish(f"revision {result.current_revision} could not be read")
    session.trace.event(session.name, "spec_extract", pages=len(pages))
    by_id: dict[str, Requirement] = {}

    async def extract(text: str) -> SpecPage | None:
        page = await _extract_page(text, history.document, result.current_revision, goal_context, session.trace,
                                   session.name)
        if page and on_requirement and not (page.revision_shown and not same_revision(page.revision_shown,
                                                                                      result.current_revision)):
            for seen in page.requirements:
                try:
                    req = _parse_requirement(seen, result.current_revision)
                except ParseError:
                    continue
                if req.requirement_id not in streamed:
                    streamed.add(req.requirement_id)
                    on_requirement(req)
        return page

    streamed: set[str] = set()
    extracted = await asyncio.gather(*(extract(p) for p in pages))
    for page in extracted:
        if page is None:
            result.problems.append("a document page could not be extracted")
            continue
        if page.revision_shown and not same_revision(page.revision_shown, result.current_revision):
            result.problems.append(f"a page shows revision {page.revision_shown}, not {result.current_revision}")
            continue
        for seen in page.requirements:
            try:
                req = _parse_requirement(seen, result.current_revision)
            except ParseError as error:
                result.problems.append(f"{seen.requirement_id}: {error}")
                continue
            if seen.conflict:
                result.problems.append(f"{req.requirement_id}: {seen.conflict}")
            if req.requirement_id in by_id and by_id[req.requirement_id].raw != req.raw:
                result.problems.append(f"{req.requirement_id} read differently on two pages")
            by_id.setdefault(req.requirement_id, req)
    result.requirements = sorted(by_id.values(), key=lambda r: calc.position_key(r.requirement_id))
    return finish()

MATERIAL_INSTRUCTIONS = """\

the freely usable quantity only, never a total that includes blocked or inspection stock. Leave a fact '' when no
view shows it (views that show a sign-in or notice page instead do not count); never fill in 0 or a guess.
Report every price
condition record you see, older ones too, each with its own validity, currency, exchange-rate key, price unit,
declared number format and all of its quantity scales."""


def _want(req: EffectiveRequirement) -> str:
    stroke = f"stroke {req.stroke} mm" if req.stroke is not None else "stroke not yet known (ignore it)"
    return (f"bore {req.bore} mm, {stroke}, pressure {req.pressure} bar, mounting {req.mounting}, certification "
            f"{req.certification}")


def _num(text: str) -> Decimal | None:
    try:
        return parse_number(text) if text and text.strip() else None
    except ParseError:
        return None


def _material_record(seen: MaterialSeen) -> MaterialRecord:
    problems: list[str] = []

    def get(fn, text, *args):
        if not text or not str(text).strip():
            return None
        try:
            return fn(text, *args)
        except (ParseError, ValueError) as error:
            problems.append(str(error))
            return None

    conditions = []
    for c in seen.conditions:
        fmt = number_format(c.number_format) if c.number_format else None
        if not c.scales:
            problems.append(f"condition {c.valid_from}..{c.valid_to}: scales not read")
            continue
        try:
            scales = [calc.PriceScale(min_quantity=parse_int(s.min_quantity, fmt),
                                      price=parse_number(s.price, fmt)) for s in c.scales]
            conditions.append(calc.PriceCondition(
                valid_from=parse_date(c.valid_from), valid_to=parse_date(c.valid_to) if c.valid_to.strip() else None,
                currency=c.currency.strip().upper()[:3] or "EUR", fx_key=c.fx_key.strip() or None,
                price_unit=parse_int(c.price_unit), scales=scales))
        except (ParseError, ValueError) as error:
            problems.append(f"condition {c.valid_from}..{c.valid_to}: {error}")
    return MaterialRecord(
        material_number=seen.material_number.strip(), active=seen.active,
        status=f"{seen.status_code} ({seen.status_meaning})", bore=_num(seen.bore), stroke=_num(seen.stroke),
        pressure=_num(seen.pressure), mounting=seen.mounting.strip(), certification=seen.certification.strip(),
        free_stock=get(parse_int, seen.free_stock), blocked_stock=get(parse_int, seen.blocked_stock),
        stock_lead_time_weeks=get(parse_weeks, seen.stock_lead_time),
        production_lead_time_weeks=get(parse_weeks, seen.production_lead_time),
        pieces_per_carton=get(parse_int, seen.pieces_per_carton),
        allocation_mass_kg=get(parse_mass_kg, seen.allocation_mass),
        surcharge_mass_kg=get(parse_mass_kg, seen.surcharge_mass), metal_index=seen.metal_index.strip() or None,
        conditions=conditions, raw=seen.model_dump(), problems=problems)


def _keep_views(session: SiteSession, views: dict[str, str] | None = None) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Remember the latest text of every page this session shows (by URL), for the reader after navigation."""
    views = {} if views is None else views
    look = session.look

    async def recording_look(offset: int = 0) -> str:
        out = await look(offset)
        if offset == 0:
            views[session.page.url] = _strip_refs(session.view)
        return out

    session.look = recording_look  # type: ignore[method-assign]
    return views


def _corpus(views: dict[str, str]) -> str:
    """The kept views as one text, site chrome shown once."""
    texts = list(views.values())
    head, tail = _common_edges(texts)
    parts = []
    for i, (url, text) in enumerate(views.items()):
        lines = text.splitlines()
        if i and (head or tail):
            lines = lines[head:len(lines) - tail]
        parts.append(f"=== {url}\n" + "\n".join(lines))
    return "\n\n".join(parts)


async def _read_material(number: str, corpus: str, trace: Trace, name: str) -> MaterialSeen:
    return await _grounded_read(MaterialSeen, MATERIAL_INSTRUCTIONS, f"Material {number}. Its ERP views:\n\n{corpus}",
                                corpus, trace=trace, name=name, what="material views")


MAX_INSPECT = int(os.environ.get("ERP_MAX_INSPECT", "10"))


def incomplete(record: MaterialRecord) -> list[str]:
    """Facts every bid needs from a material that its record still lacks."""
    checks = {"status": bool(record.status.strip(" ()")), "free stock": record.free_stock is not None,
              "lead time from stock": record.stock_lead_time_weeks is not None,
              "production lead time": record.production_lead_time_weeks is not None,
              "price conditions with their quantity scales": bool(record.conditions)
              and not any("scales not read" in p for p in record.problems),
              "pieces per carton": record.pieces_per_carton is not None,
              "allocation and surcharge masses": record.allocation_mass_kg is not None
              and record.surcharge_mass_kg is not None}
    return [name for name, ok in checks.items() if not ok]

class Erp:
    """The ERP website: one signed-in context, a tab per worker, so requirements and materials run in parallel."""

    def __init__(self, site: dict, context: BrowserContext, trace: Trace, deadline: float | None = None):
        self.site, self.context, self.trace, self.deadline = site, context, trace, deadline
        self.ready: asyncio.Task | None = None
        self.materials: dict[str, asyncio.Task] = {}
        self.active_at = 0.0  # last time a worker was using the ERP
        self.busy = 0
        self.lock = asyncio.Lock()
        self.idle_limit = float(os.environ.get("ERP_IDLE_SECONDS", "200"))
        self.tasks: dict[str, asyncio.Task] = {}
        # a few tabs at once: when the ERP drops its session, every open tab signs in again at the same moment
        self.tabs = asyncio.Semaphore(int(os.environ.get("ERP_TABS", "8")))
        self.started_at: float | None = None

    def warm_up(self) -> asyncio.Task:
        """Sign in and get past entry gates once (a model handles gates the helpers cannot), e.g. while the
        specification is still being read."""
        if self.ready is None:
            self.ready = asyncio.create_task(self._warm_up())
        return self.ready

    async def _warm_up(self) -> None:
        session = await self._tab("start")
        await run_worker(session, "Get to the system's main menu or start screen, past any notice or confirmation "
                         "it asks for first, then return.", Ready, deadline=self.deadline, max_steps=12,
                         **_worker_kwargs(notes=False, grounded=False))
        await self._close(session)
        self.active_at = time.monotonic()

    async def _enter(self) -> None:
        """Before a worker starts: a tab slot, and the session signed in and not about to time out. When it sat
        idle for long (the ERP logs out after a few minutes), one tab signs in again before the others pile in."""
        await self.warm_up()
        await self.tabs.acquire()
        async with self.lock:
            if not self.busy and time.monotonic() - self.active_at > self.idle_limit:
                self.ready = None
                await self.warm_up()
            self.busy += 1

    def _leave(self) -> None:
        self.tabs.release()
        self.busy -= 1
        self.active_at = time.monotonic()

    async def _tab(self, tag: str, url: str | None = None) -> SiteSession:
        """A new tab in the shared context; `tag` only names it in the trace."""
        session = SiteSession({**self.site, "siteId": f"{self.site['siteId']}:{tag}"}, self.context, self.trace)
        await session.start()
        if url:
            await self.open(session, url)
        return session

    async def open(self, session: SiteSession, url: str) -> bool:
        """Open a link target a model reported, with the same rule as the goto tool: only on this website."""
        target = on_site(self.site, url)
        if target is None:
            self.trace.event(session.name, "link_refused", url=url)
            return False
        async with session.lock:
            await session._goto(target)
        await session.look()
        return True

    @staticmethod
    async def _close(session: SiteSession) -> None:
        for page in session.pages:
            try:
                await page.close()
            except Exception:  # already gone
                continue

    async def requirement(self, req: EffectiveRequirement) -> RequirementResearch:
        out = RequirementResearch(requirement_id=req.requirement_id)
        report = None
        for attempt in range(2):  # retry once: the ERP sometimes drops the session mid-search
            await self._enter()
            try:
                session = await self._tab(req.requirement_id if not attempt else f"{req.requirement_id}+")
                report, _ = await run_worker(session, SEARCH_GOAL.format(group=req.catalog_group, want=_want(req)),
                                             SearchReport, deadline=self.deadline, max_steps=14,
                                             **_worker_kwargs(notes=False))
                await self._close(session)
            finally:
                self._leave()
            if report is not None:
                break
        if report is None:
            out.problems.append("search worker returned no result")
            return out
        out.search_term = report.search_term
        out.candidates = [Candidate(material_number=c.material_number.strip(), link=c.link.strip(),
                                    bore=_num(c.bore), stroke=_num(c.stroke), pressure=_num(c.pressure),
                                    mounting=c.mounting, certification=c.certification)
                          for c in report.candidates]
        # every hit of the model's search is inspected (the rules cap a usable search at 20 hits); which one fits is
        # the model's choice below, once the details are known
        out.inspected = list(dict.fromkeys(c.material_number for c in out.candidates))[:MAX_INSPECT]
        if len(out.candidates) > MAX_INSPECT:
            out.problems.append(f"{len(out.candidates)} hits, inspected the first {MAX_INSPECT}")
        links = {c.material_number: c.link for c in out.candidates}
        records = await asyncio.gather(*(self.material(number, links.get(number, "")) for number in out.inspected))
        materials = {r.material_number: r for r in records if r is not None}
        out.selected, problems = await choose_material(req, out, materials, self.trace)
        out.problems += problems
        return out

    def material(self, number: str, link: str = "") -> asyncio.Task:
        """One detail worker per material, shared when several requirements inspect the same one."""

async def research_spec(session: SiteSession, briefing: Briefing, *, context: str = "",
                        deadline: float | None = None, on_requirement=None, on_revision=None) -> SpecResult:
    """
    The current specification revision's requirements: a worker finds the document and its revision history
    (navigation, thinking off), a model decides the current revision (thinking on), the worker opens it and pages
    through it, and a model extracts each page (thinking on, in parallel).

    `on_revision()` runs once the governing revision is chosen (e.g. to warm up the ERP), `on_requirement(req)` as
    soon as each requirement is parsed, so ERP research can start before the last page is read.
    """
    started = time.monotonic()
    result = SpecResult()
    goal_context = f"Tender reference: {briefing.tender_reference}\n{context}".strip()

    def finish(problem: str | None = None) -> SpecResult:
        if problem:
            result.problems.append(problem)
        result.seconds = round(time.monotonic() - started, 1)
        session.trace.event(session.name, "spec_done", seconds=result.seconds, revision=result.current_revision,
                            requirements=[r.requirement_id for r in result.requirements], problems=result.problems)
        return result

    history, _ = await run_worker(session, FIND_SPEC_GOAL, RevisionHistory, context=goal_context, deadline=deadline,
                                  max_steps=25, **_worker_kwargs(notes=False))
    if history is None or not history.revisions:
        return finish("no revision history found")
    result.document = history.document
    result.revisions = [SpecRevision(revision=r.revision, status_shown=r.status) for r in history.revisions]
    choice = await _choose_revision(history, session.view, goal_context)
    if choice is None:
        return finish("no current revision chosen")
    result.current_revision = choice.revision.strip()
    session.trace.event(session.name, "spec_revision", revision=result.current_revision, why=choice.why)
    if on_revision:
        on_revision()

    for _ in range(2):
        await run_worker(session, OPEN_REVISION_GOAL.format(revision=result.current_revision), Opened,
                         context=goal_context, deadline=deadline, max_steps=12, tools=(read_document,),
                         **_worker_kwargs(notes=False, grounded=False))
        pages = _DOCUMENTS.pop(id(session), [])
        if pages:
            break
    else:
        return finish(f"revision {result.current_revision} could not be read")
    session.trace.event(session.name, "spec_extract", pages=len(pages))
    by_id: dict[str, Requirement] = {}

    async def extract(text: str) -> SpecPage | None:
        page = await _extract_page(text, history.document, result.current_revision, goal_context, session.trace,
                                   session.name)
        if page and on_requirement and not (page.revision_shown and not same_revision(page.revision_shown,
                                                                                      result.current_revision)):
            for seen in page.requirements:
                try:
                    req = _parse_requirement(seen, result.current_revision)
                except ParseError:
                    continue
                if req.requirement_id not in streamed:
                    streamed.add(req.requirement_id)
                    on_requirement(req)
        return page

    streamed: set[str] = set()
    extracted = await asyncio.gather(*(extract(p) for p in pages))
    for page in extracted:
        if page is None:
            result.problems.append("a document page could not be extracted")
            continue
        if page.revision_shown and not same_revision(page.revision_shown, result.current_revision):
            result.problems.append(f"a page shows revision {page.revision_shown}, not {result.current_revision}")
            continue
        for seen in page.requirements:
            try:
                req = _parse_requirement(seen, result.current_revision)
            except ParseError as error:
                result.problems.append(f"{seen.requirement_id}: {error}")
                continue
            if seen.conflict:
                result.problems.append(f"{req.requirement_id}: {seen.conflict}")
            if req.requirement_id in by_id and by_id[req.requirement_id].raw != req.raw:
                result.problems.append(f"{req.requirement_id} read differently on two pages")
            by_id.setdefault(req.requirement_id, req)
    result.requirements = sorted(by_id.values(), key=lambda r: calc.position_key(r.requirement_id))
    return finish()

def _material_record(seen: MaterialSeen) -> MaterialRecord:

        if not c.scales:
            problems.append(f"condition {c.valid_from}..{c.valid_to}: scales not read")
            continue
        try:
