                                      price=parse_number(s.price, fmt)) for s in c.scales]
            conditions.append(calc.PriceCondition(
                valid_from=parse_date(c.valid_from), valid_to=parse_date(c.valid_to) if c.valid_to.strip() else None,
                currency=c.currency.strip().upper()[:3] or "EUR", fx_key=c.fx_key.strip() or None,
                price_unit=parse_int(c.price_unit), scales=scales))
        except (ParseError, ValueError) as error:
            problems.append(f"condition {c.valid_from}..{c.valid_to}: {error}")
    return MaterialRecord(
        material_number=seen.material_number.strip(), active=seen.active,
        status=f"{seen.status_code} ({seen.status_meaning})", bore=_num(seen.bore), stroke=_num(seen.stroke),
        pressure=_num(seen.pressure), mounting=seen.mounting.strip(), certification=seen.certification.strip(),
        free_stock=get(parse_int, seen.free_stock), blocked_stock=get(parse_int, seen.blocked_stock),
        stock_lead_time_weeks=get(parse_weeks, seen.stock_lead_time),
        production_lead_time_weeks=get(parse_weeks, seen.production_lead_time),
        pieces_per_carton=get(parse_int, seen.pieces_per_carton),
        allocation_mass_kg=get(parse_mass_kg, seen.allocation_mass),
        surcharge_mass_kg=get(parse_mass_kg, seen.surcharge_mass), metal_index=seen.metal_index.strip() or None,
        conditions=conditions, raw=seen.model_dump(), problems=problems)


def _keep_views(session: SiteSession, views: dict[str, str] | None = None) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Remember the latest text of every page this session shows (by URL), for the reader after navigation."""
    views = {} if views is None else views
    look = session.look

    async def recording_look(offset: int = 0) -> str:
        out = await look(offset)
        if offset == 0:
            views[session.page.url] = _strip_refs(session.view)
        return out

    session.look = recording_look  # type: ignore[method-assign]
    return views


def _corpus(views: dict[str, str]) -> str:
    """The kept views as one text, site chrome shown once."""
    texts = list(views.values())
    head, tail = _common_edges(texts)
    parts = []
    for i, (url, text) in enumerate(views.items()):
        lines = text.splitlines()
        if i and (head or tail):
            lines = lines[head:len(lines) - tail]
        parts.append(f"=== {url}\n" + "\n".join(lines))
    return "\n\n".join(parts)


async def _read_material(number: str, corpus: str, trace: Trace, name: str) -> MaterialSeen:
    return await _grounded_read(MaterialSeen, MATERIAL_INSTRUCTIONS, f"Material {number}. Its ERP views:\n\n{corpus}",
                                corpus, trace=trace, name=name, what="material views")


MAX_INSPECT = int(os.environ.get("ERP_MAX_INSPECT", "10"))


def incomplete(record: MaterialRecord) -> list[str]:
    """Facts every bid needs from a material that its record still lacks."""
    checks = {"status": bool(record.status.strip(" ()")), "free stock": record.free_stock is not None,
              "lead time from stock": record.stock_lead_time_weeks is not None,
              "production lead time": record.production_lead_time_weeks is not None,
              "price conditions with their quantity scales": bool(record.conditions)
              and not any("scales not read" in p for p in record.problems),
              "pieces per carton": record.pieces_per_carton is not None,
              "allocation and surcharge masses": record.allocation_mass_kg is not None
              and record.surcharge_mass_kg is not None}
    return [name for name, ok in checks.items() if not ok]


class ErpResearch(BaseModel):
    requirements: list[RequirementResearch] = Field(default_factory=list)
    materials: dict[str, MaterialRecord] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    seconds: float = 0


class Erp:
    """The ERP website: one signed-in context, a tab per worker, so requirements and materials run in parallel."""

    def __init__(self, site: dict, context: BrowserContext, trace: Trace, deadline: float | None = None):
        self.site, self.context, self.trace, self.deadline = site, context, trace, deadline
        self.ready: asyncio.Task | None = None
        self.materials: dict[str, asyncio.Task] = {}
        self.active_at = 0.0  # last time a worker was using the ERP
        self.busy = 0
        self.lock = asyncio.Lock()
        self.idle_limit = float(os.environ.get("ERP_IDLE_SECONDS", "200"))
        self.tasks: dict[str, asyncio.Task] = {}
        # a few tabs at once: when the ERP drops its session, every open tab signs in again at the same moment
        self.tabs = asyncio.Semaphore(int(os.environ.get("ERP_TABS", "8")))
        self.started_at: float | None = None

    def warm_up(self) -> asyncio.Task:
        """Sign in and get past entry gates once (a model handles gates the helpers cannot), e.g. while the
        specification is still being read."""
        if self.ready is None:
            self.ready = asyncio.create_task(self._warm_up())
        return self.ready

    async def _warm_up(self) -> None:
        session = await self._tab("start")
        await run_worker(session, "Get to the system's main menu or start screen, past any notice or confirmation "
                         "it asks for first, then return.", Ready, deadline=self.deadline, max_steps=12,
                         **_worker_kwargs(notes=False, grounded=False))
        await self._close(session)
        self.active_at = time.monotonic()

    async def _enter(self) -> None:
        """Before a worker starts: a tab slot, and the session signed in and not about to time out. When it sat
        idle for long (the ERP logs out after a few minutes), one tab signs in again before the others pile in."""
        await self.warm_up()
        await self.tabs.acquire()
        async with self.lock:
            if not self.busy and time.monotonic() - self.active_at > self.idle_limit:
                self.ready = None
                await self.warm_up()
            self.busy += 1

    def _leave(self) -> None:
        self.tabs.release()
        self.busy -= 1
        self.active_at = time.monotonic()

    async def _tab(self, tag: str, url: str | None = None) -> SiteSession:
        """A new tab in the shared context; `tag` only names it in the trace."""
        session = SiteSession({**self.site, "siteId": f"{self.site['siteId']}:{tag}"}, self.context, self.trace)
        await session.start()
        if url:
            await self.open(session, url)
        return session

    async def open(self, session: SiteSession, url: str) -> bool:
        """Open a link target a model reported, with the same rule as the goto tool: only on this website."""
        target = on_site(self.site, url)
        if target is None:
            self.trace.event(session.name, "link_refused", url=url)
            return False
        async with session.lock:
            await session._goto(target)
        await session.look()
        return True

    @staticmethod
    async def _close(session: SiteSession) -> None:
        for page in session.pages:
            try:
                await page.close()
            except Exception:  # already gone
                continue

    async def requirement(self, req: EffectiveRequirement) -> RequirementResearch:
        out = RequirementResearch(requirement_id=req.requirement_id)
        report = None
        for attempt in range(2):  # retry once: the ERP sometimes drops the session mid-search
            await self._enter()
            try:
                session = await self._tab(req.requirement_id if not attempt else f"{req.requirement_id}+")
                report, _ = await run_worker(session, SEARCH_GOAL.format(group=req.catalog_group, want=_want(req)),
                                             SearchReport, deadline=self.deadline, max_steps=14,
                                             **_worker_kwargs(notes=False))
                await self._close(session)
            finally:
                self._leave()
            if report is not None:
                break
        if report is None:
            out.problems.append("search worker returned no result")
            return out
        out.search_term = report.search_term
        out.candidates = [Candidate(material_number=c.material_number.strip(), link=c.link.strip(),
                                    bore=_num(c.bore), stroke=_num(c.stroke), pressure=_num(c.pressure),
                                    mounting=c.mounting, certification=c.certification)
                          for c in report.candidates]
        # every hit of the model's search is inspected (the rules cap a usable search at 20 hits); which one fits is
        # the model's choice below, once the details are known
        out.inspected = list(dict.fromkeys(c.material_number for c in out.candidates))[:MAX_INSPECT]
        if len(out.candidates) > MAX_INSPECT:
            out.problems.append(f"{len(out.candidates)} hits, inspected the first {MAX_INSPECT}")
        links = {c.material_number: c.link for c in out.candidates}
        records = await asyncio.gather(*(self.material(number, links.get(number, "")) for number in out.inspected))
        materials = {r.material_number: r for r in records if r is not None}
        out.selected, problems = await choose_material(req, out, materials, self.trace)
        out.problems += problems
        return out

    def material(self, number: str, link: str = "") -> asyncio.Task:
        """One detail worker per material, shared when several requirements inspect the same one."""

"""
The model behind the workers: the hosted Qwen through the run's metering proxy by default.

AGENT_MODEL picks another model on the same OpenAI-compatible endpoint (QWEN_BASE_URL). Thinking is off for
navigation steps, which makes a step about three times faster, and on where a worker has to weigh evidence.
"""
import os
import time

import httpx2
from openai import AsyncOpenAI
from pydantic_ai.models.openai import OpenAIChatModel
from pydantic_ai.providers.openai import OpenAIProvider
from pydantic_ai.settings import ModelSettings

QWEN_MODEL = "qwen3.8-flash-next"
os.environ.setdefault("PYDANTIC_AI_NO_BANNER", "1")


async def _sent(request: httpx2.Request) -> None:
    request.extensions["sent_at"] = time.monotonic()


async def _answered(response: httpx2.Response) -> None:
    """Log each model call's status and seconds, so slow or hanging calls show in the run logs."""
    seconds = time.monotonic() - response.request.extensions.get("sent_at", time.monotonic())
    print(f"[model] {response.status_code} {seconds:.1f}s {len(response.request.content or b'')} bytes", flush=True)


def model() -> OpenAIChatModel:
    # The run waits for the hosted models to warm up, so a step answers in seconds; now and then a call hangs
    # until the proxy drops it minutes later, so give up early and retry instead.
    client = AsyncOpenAI(base_url=os.environ["QWEN_BASE_URL"], api_key=os.environ["QWEN_API_KEY"],
                         timeout=float(os.environ.get("LLM_TIMEOUT", "30")), max_retries=6,
                         http_client=httpx2.AsyncClient(event_hooks={"request": [_sent], "response": [_answered]}))
    return OpenAIChatModel(os.environ.get("AGENT_MODEL", QWEN_MODEL), provider=OpenAIProvider(openai_client=client))


def thinking(phase: str, default: bool) -> bool:
    """Whether `phase` (BRIEF, FORM, REVIEW, ...) thinks: THINKING_<PHASE>=0/1 overrides the default, so
    experiments can switch it per phase and the run records say which way it ran."""
    value = os.environ.get(f"THINKING_{phase.upper()}", "").strip().lower()
    return default if not value else value not in ("0", "false", "no", "off")


def settings(thinking: bool = False) -> ModelSettings:
    return ModelSettings(
        temperature=0.2,
        parallel_tool_calls=False,  # one tab per worker: actions must run in order
        extra_body={"chat_template_kwargs": {"enable_thinking": thinking}},
    )

"""
v2 research check: read the brief, then the specification worker and the ERP workers, and print their records.

Run from the repo root with the scouting logins and the models proxy:
    eval "$(atira scout --env)"; HEADLESS=1 uv run --project agent python dev/research_check.py \
        [--reserve KEY=MM ...] [--only ID ...]

Usable-travel reserves come from the Technikfreigabe mail (another worker); pass them with --reserve to see the final
selection, otherwise those strokes stay pending and the ERP stage inspects every hit that matches the rest.
"""
import argparse
import asyncio
import json
import sys
import time
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "agent"))

from playwright.async_api import async_playwright  # noqa: E402

import browsers  # noqa: E402
import calc  # noqa: E402
import run as contract  # noqa: E402
from briefing import read_brief  # noqa: E402
from browser_tools import SiteSession  # noqa: E402
from evidence import effective_requirement, parse_date  # noqa: E402
from research import Erp, research_sites, research_spec, reselect  # noqa: E402
from tracing import Trace  # noqa: E402


def _drop_raw(value):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {k: _drop_raw(v) for k, v in value.items() if k != "raw"}
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [_drop_raw(v) for v in value]
    return value


def dump(model) -> str:
    return json.dumps(_drop_raw(json.loads(model.model_dump_json())), ensure_ascii=False)


async def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--reserve", action="append", default=[], help="KEY=per-end reserve in mm")
    parser.add_argument("--only", action="append", default=[], help="only these requirement ids in the ERP stage")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    reserves = {k: Decimal(v) for k, v in (r.split("=", 1) for r in args.reserve)}

    task, _ = contract.load_run()
    trace = Trace()
    t0 = time.monotonic()
    deadline = t0 + 15 * 60
    context = task["brief"].split("## Rules")[0].strip()
    briefing, sites = await asyncio.gather(read_brief(task), research_sites(task))
    t_brief = time.monotonic() - t0
    print(f"\nbrief read in {t_brief:.1f}s: tender {briefing.tender_reference}, spec site {sites.spec_site}, "
          f"ERP site {sites.erp_site}", flush=True)
    access = {s["siteId"]: s for s in task["access"]}
    async with async_playwright() as playwright:
        spec_ctx, erp_ctx = await browsers.contexts(playwright, 2)
        spec_session = SiteSession(access[sites.spec_site], spec_ctx, trace)
        erp = Erp(access[sites.erp_site], erp_ctx, trace, deadline)
        erp.warm_up()  # signs in to the ERP while the specification is read
        await spec_session.start()
        scenario = parse_date(briefing.scenario_date)
        effective = {}

        def on_requirement(req):  # ERP research starts as soon as the specification yields a requirement
            if args.only and req.requirement_id not in args.only:
                return
            effective[req.requirement_id] = effective_requirement(req, amendments=[], reserves=reserves,
                                                                  scenario_date=scenario)
            print(f"[{time.monotonic() - t0:7.1f}s] requirement {req.requirement_id} -> ERP", flush=True)
            erp.start(effective[req.requirement_id])

        spec = await research_spec(spec_session, briefing, context=context, deadline=deadline,
                                   on_requirement=on_requirement)
        t_spec = time.monotonic() - t0
        print(f"\n===== specification ({spec.seconds}s, at {t_spec:.1f}s)\n{dump(spec)}", flush=True)
        wanted = [r for r in spec.requirements if not args.only or r.requirement_id in args.only]
        for req in wanted:  # anything a page reported only after a disagreement check
            if req.requirement_id not in effective:
                on_requirement(req)
        result = await erp.collect()
        t_erp = time.monotonic() - t0
    print(f"\n===== ERP ({result.seconds}s, at {t_erp:.1f}s)")
    for research in result.requirements:
        print(dump(research))
    for number, record in sorted(result.materials.items()):
        print(f"--- material {number}\n{dump(record)}")

    print("\n===== mapped to calc inputs")
    chosen = await reselect(list(effective.values()), result, trace)
    for req in wanted:
        number = chosen.get(req.requirement_id)
        record = result.materials.get(number) if number else None
        line = f"{req.requirement_id}: group {req.catalog_group} -> {number or 'NO MATERIAL (pending or none)'}"
        if record:
            try:
                material = record.to_material()
                cond = calc.valid_condition(record.conditions, scenario)
                line += (f"; stock {material.free_stock}, lead {material.stock_lead_time_weeks}/"
                         f"{material.production_lead_time_weeks} w, carton {material.pieces_per_carton}, masses "
                         f"{material.allocation_mass}/{material.surcharge_mass} kg, index {material.metal_index}; "
                         f"valid condition {cond.valid_from}..{cond.valid_to} {cond.currency} {cond.fx_key or ''} "
                         f"per {cond.price_unit}: " + ", ".join(f"{s.min_quantity}+ {s.price}" for s in cond.scales))
            except calc.CalcError as error:
                line += f"; calc error: {error}"
        print(line)
    print(f"\ntimings: brief {t_brief:.1f}s, spec done at {t_spec:.1f}s, ERP done at {t_erp:.1f}s "
          f"(ERP stage {result.seconds}s)\ntrace: {trace.path}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())
#!/bin/sh
# Run the agent locally against the public scouting sites (headless) and record it in experiments/local-runs.jsonl
# (gitignored). Usage, from anywhere: dev/run-local.sh <version> ["note"] [experiment]
# Needs `atira login` and `atira models proxy` running in another terminal. HEADLESS=0 shows the browser.
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." || exit 1
version=${1:?usage: dev/run-local.sh <version> [note] [experiment]}
note=${2:-}
experiment=${3:-}
curl -s --max-time 5 -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:8765/ || {
  echo "The models proxy is not running: start \`atira models proxy\` in another terminal first."; exit 1; }
commit=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)
dirty=no; [ -n "$(git status --porcelain -- agent)" ] && dirty=yes
traces="$PWD/agent/traces/$(date -u +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
mkdir -p "$traces"
eval "$(atira scout --env)"
(cd agent && uv sync -q && HEADLESS=${HEADLESS:-1} TRACE_DIR="$traces" uv run --no-sync python agent.py)
status=$?
trace=$(ls "$traces"/run-*.jsonl 2>/dev/null | head -1)
[ -n "$trace" ] || { echo "The agent wrote no trace; nothing recorded."; exit $status; }
python3 dev/track.py local --trace "$trace" --version "$version" --experiment "$experiment" --note "$note" \
  --commit "$commit" --dirty "$dirty" && python3 dev/track.py report
exit $status
research_check.py
run-local.sh
smoke.py
test-run.sh
track.py

        effective = {}

        def on_requirement(req):  # ERP research starts as soon as the specification yields a requirement
            if args.only and req.requirement_id not in args.only:
                return
            effective[req.requirement_id] = effective_requirement(req, amendments=[], reserves=reserves,
                                                                  scenario_date=scenario)
            print(f"[{time.monotonic() - t0:7.1f}s] requirement {req.requirement_id} -> ERP", flush=True)
            erp.start(effective[req.requirement_id])

        spec = await research_spec(spec_session, briefing, context=context, deadline=deadline,
                                   on_requirement=on_requirement)
        t_spec = time.monotonic() - t0
        print(f"\n===== specification ({spec.seconds}s, at {t_spec:.1f}s)\n{dump(spec)}", flush=True)
        wanted = [r for r in spec.requirements if not args.only or r.requirement_id in args.only]
        for req in wanted:  # anything a page reported only after a disagreement check
            if req.requirement_id not in effective:
                on_requirement(req)
        result = await erp.collect()
        t_erp = time.monotonic() - t0
    print(f"\n===== ERP ({result.seconds}s, at {t_erp:.1f}s)")
    for research in result.requirements:
        print(dump(research))
    for number, record in sorted(result.materials.items()):
        print(f"--- material {number}\n{dump(record)}")

    print("\n===== mapped to calc inputs")
    chosen = await reselect(list(effective.values()), result, trace)
    for req in wanted:
        number = chosen.get(req.requirement_id)
        record = result.materials.get(number) if number else None
        line = f"{req.requirement_id}: group {req.catalog_group} -> {number or 'NO MATERIAL (pending or none)'}"
        if record:
            try:
                material = record.to_material()
                cond = calc.valid_condition(record.conditions, scenario)
                line += (f"; stock {material.free_stock}, lead {material.stock_lead_time_weeks}/"
                         f"{material.production_lead_time_weeks} w, carton {material.pieces_per_carton}, masses "
                         f"{material.allocation_mass}/{material.surcharge_mass} kg, index {material.metal_index}; "
                         f"valid condition {cond.valid_from}..{cond.valid_to} {cond.currency} {cond.fx_key or ''} "
                         f"per {cond.price_unit}: " + ", ".join(f"{s.min_quantity}+ {s.price}" for s in cond.scales))
            except calc.CalcError as error:
                line += f"; calc error: {error}"
        print(line)
    print(f"\ntimings: brief {t_brief:.1f}s, spec done at {t_spec:.1f}s, ERP done at {t_erp:.1f}s "
          f"(ERP stage {result.seconds}s)\ntrace: {trace.path}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())
#!/bin/sh
# Run the agent locally against the public scouting sites (headless) and record it in experiments/local-runs.jsonl
# (gitignored). Usage, from anywhere: dev/run-local.sh <version> ["note"] [experiment]
# Needs `atira login` and `atira models proxy` running in another terminal. HEADLESS=0 shows the browser.
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." || exit 1
version=${1:?usage: dev/run-local.sh <version> [note] [experiment]}
note=${2:-}
experiment=${3:-}
curl -s --max-time 5 -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:8765/ || {
  echo "The models proxy is not running: start \`atira models proxy\` in another terminal first."; exit 1; }
commit=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)
dirty=no; [ -n "$(git status --porcelain -- agent)" ] && dirty=yes
traces="$PWD/agent/traces/$(date -u +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
mkdir -p "$traces"
eval "$(atira scout --env)"
(cd agent && uv sync -q && HEADLESS=${HEADLESS:-1} TRACE_DIR="$traces" uv run --no-sync python agent.py)
status=$?
trace=$(ls "$traces"/run-*.jsonl 2>/dev/null | head -1)
[ -n "$trace" ] || { echo "The agent wrote no trace; nothing recorded."; exit $status; }
python3 dev/track.py local --trace "$trace" --version "$version" --experiment "$experiment" --note "$note" \
  --commit "$commit" --dirty "$dirty" && python3 dev/track.py report
exit $status
research_check.py
run-local.sh
smoke.py
test-run.sh
track.py
